// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\account-detail\account-detail.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AccountService } from '../../core/services/account.service';
import { CheckInService } from '../../core/services/check-in.service';
import { RoomAttentionService } from '../../core/services/room-attention.service';
import { AccountDTOResponse } from '../../models/Account-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-account-detail',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './account-detail.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./account-detail.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class AccountDetailComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  checkInId!: number;
  account = signal<AccountDTOResponse | null>(null);
  checkInState = signal<string>('');
  loading = signal<boolean>(true);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');

  // Formulario de pago
  paymentAmount = signal<number>(0);
  paymentMethod = signal<string>('CASH');
  transactionReference = signal<string>('');

  // Ajuste por porcentaje
  adjustmentPercentage = signal<number>(0);
  adjustedTotal = signal<number>(0);

  constructor(
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private router: Router,
    private accountService: AccountService,
    private checkInService: CheckInService,
    private roomAttentionService: RoomAttentionService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (idParam) {
      this.checkInId = +idParam;
      this.loadData();
    }
  }

  loadData(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.accountService.getAccountByCheckInId(this.checkInId).subscribe({
      next: (accountData: AccountDTOResponse) => {
        this.account.set(accountData);
        this.adjustmentPercentage.set(accountData.adjustmentPercentage ?? 0);

        this.roomAttentionService.getByBooking(this.checkInId).subscribe({
          next: (attentions) => {
            const currentAccount = this.account();
            if (currentAccount) {
              const mappedItems = attentions.map(att => ({
                description: att.itemDTOResponse?.description || 'Room Service / Consumo',
                quantity: att.quantity,
                subtotal: att.subtotal
              }));
              
              this.account.set({
                ...currentAccount,
                items: mappedItems
              });
            }

            this.adjustedTotal.set(this.calculateAdjustedTotal());
            this.paymentAmount.set(this.calculateRemaining());

            this.checkInService.getAll().subscribe({
              next: (checkIns) => {
                const currentCheckIn = checkIns.find(c => c.id === this.checkInId);
                if (currentCheckIn) {
                  this.checkInState.set(currentCheckIn.checkInState);
                }
                this.loading.set(false);
              },
              error: () => {
                this.loading.set(false);
              }
            });
          },
          error: (attErr) => {
            console.error('Error al cargar las atenciones de habitaciÃ³n:', attErr);
            this.loading.set(false);
          }
        });
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar el resumen de la cuenta.');
        this.loading.set(false);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  calculateRawTotal(): number {
    const acc = this.account();
    if (!acc) return 0;
    const base = acc.baseAmount ?? 0;
    const itemsTotal = acc.items ? acc.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.subtotal, 0) : 0;
    return base + itemsTotal;
  }

  calculateAdjustmentAmount(): number {
    return this.calculateRawTotal() * (this.adjustmentPercentage() / 100);
  }

  applyAdjustments(): void {
    const acc = this.account();
    if (!acc || acc.isPaid) return;

    this.accountService.updateAdjustmentPercentage(this.checkInId, this.adjustmentPercentage()).subscribe({
      next: (updatedAccount: AccountDTOResponse) => {
        this.account.set(updatedAccount);
        this.adjustmentPercentage.set(updatedAccount.adjustmentPercentage ?? this.adjustmentPercentage());
        this.adjustedTotal.set(this.calculateAdjustedTotal());
        this.paymentAmount.set(this.calculateRemaining());
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        alert('Error al aplicar el porcentaje de ajuste.');
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  calculateAdjustedTotal(): number {
    const rawTotal = this.calculateRawTotal();
    const adjustmentFactor = 1 + (this.adjustmentPercentage() / 100);
    return rawTotal * adjustmentFactor;
  }

  calculateRemaining(): number {
    const acc = this.account();
    if (!acc) return 0;
    const totalPaid = acc.payments ? acc.payments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amount, 0) : 0;
    return Math.max(0, this.calculateAdjustedTotal() - totalPaid);
  }

  submitPayment(): void {
    const acc = this.account();
    if (!acc || this.paymentAmount() <= 0 || acc.isPaid) return;

    const paymentPayload = {
      accountId: acc.id,
      amount: this.paymentAmount(),
      paymentMethod: this.paymentMethod(),
      transactionReference: this.transactionReference() || 'Pago en mostrador'
    };

    this.accountService.addPayment(paymentPayload).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.paymentAmount.set(0);
        this.transactionReference.set('');
        this.loadData();
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        alert('Error al registrar el pago.');
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  goBack(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['dashboard/check-in-list']);
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterModule, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { AccountService } from '../../core/services/account.service';
import { AccountDTOResponse } from '../../models/Account-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-account-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterModule],
  templateUrl: './account-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./account-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class AccountListComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  accounts = signal<AccountDTOResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal<boolean>(true);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');

  constructor(
    private accountService: AccountService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadAccounts();
  }

  loadAccounts(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.accountService.getAllAccounts().subscribe({
      next: (data: AccountDTOResponse[]) => {
        const processedAccounts = Array.isArray(data) ? data.map(acc => {
          const base = acc.baseAmount || 0;
          const services = acc.servicesTotal || 0;
          const subtotal = base + services;
          const adjustment = acc.adjustmentPercentage || 0;
          const total = subtotal + (subtotal * (adjustment / 100));
          const paid = acc.paidAmount || 0;
          
          return {
            ...acc,
            totalAmount: total,
            remainingBalance: Math.max(0, total - paid)
          };
        }) : [];
        
        this.accounts.set(processedAccounts);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        console.error('Error cargando cuentas:', err);
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las cuentas.');
        this.accounts.set([]);
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  viewAccountDetail(id: number): void {
    this.router.navigate([`/dashboard/account-detail/${id}`]);
  }
}

          {{ loading() ? 'Consultando...' : 'Consultar Disponibilidad' }}
        </button>
      </div>

    </form>
  </div>

  <!-- Lista de Habitaciones Disponibles -->
  @if (!loading() && hasSearched()) {
    <div class="header-section" style="margin-top: 2rem;">
      <div>
        <h3 style="color: var(--color-text-main); font-size: var(--font-size-md); margin-bottom: 4px;">Habitaciones Disponibles</h3>
        <p class="subtitle">Haz clic sobre la habitaciÃ³n que deseas reservar para avanzar.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    @if (availableRooms().length > 0) {
      <div class="table-wrapper">
        <table class="table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th class="ps-4">ID</th>
              <th>Nro. HabitaciÃ³n</th>
              <th>Tipo</th>
              <th>Capacidad</th>
              <th>Precio por Noche</th>
              <th style="text-align: right; padding-right: 1.5rem;">Total Est. ({{ calculateDays() }} noches)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (room of availableRooms(); track room.id) {
              <tr (click)="selectRoomAndRedirect(room)" style="cursor: pointer;" title="Haz clic para seleccionar esta habitaciÃ³n">
                <td class="ps-4 subtitle">#{{ room.id }}</td>
                <td><strong style="color: var(--color-text-main);">#{{ room.number }}</strong></td>

              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    } @else {
      <div class="alert alert-warning text-center py-4" style="justify-content: center;">
        <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-exclamation me-2"></i> No hay habitaciones disponibles para los criterios seleccionados.
      </div>
    }
  }

</section>

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\availability\availability.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { BookingService } from '../../core/services/booking.service';
import { BookingStateService } from '../../core/services/booking-state.service';
import { RoomDtoResponse } from '../../models/Room-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-availability',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './availability.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./availability.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class AvailabilityComponent implements OnInit {
  availabilityForm!: FormGroup;
  
  // --- Estados con Signals en sintonÃ­a con tus otros componentes ---
  availableRooms = signal<RoomDtoResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal<boolean>(false);
  hasSearched = signal<boolean>(false);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');

  constructor(
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private bookingService: BookingService,
    private bookingStateService: BookingStateService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initForm();
  }

  initForm(): void {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    
    this.availabilityForm = this.fb.group({
      checkIn: [today, [Validators.required]],
      checkOut: ['', [Validators.required]],
      guestCount: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]]
    });
  }

  onSearch(): void {
    if (this.availabilityForm.invalid) {
      this.availabilityForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const { checkIn, checkOut, guestCount } = this.availabilityForm.value;

    if (checkOut <= checkIn) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La fecha de check-out debe ser posterior al check-in.');
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    this.hasSearched.set(true);

    this.bookingService.getAvailableRooms(checkIn, checkOut, guestCount).subscribe({
      next: (rooms) => {
        this.availableRooms.set(Array.isArray(rooms) ? [...rooms] : []);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al consultar la disponibilidad en el sistema.');
        this.loading.set(false);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  // <--- Calcula la cantidad de dÃ­as entre checkIn y checkOut
  calculateDays(): number {
    const { checkIn, checkOut } = this.availabilityForm.value;
    if (!checkIn || !checkOut) return 1;
    
    const start = new Date(checkIn);
    const end = new Date(checkOut);
    const diffTime = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    
    return diffDays > 0 ? diffDays : 1;
  }

  // <--- Obtiene el precio por noche de forma segura segÃºn el modelo actual
  getRoomPrice(room: RoomDtoResponse): number {
    return room.roomTypeDTOResponse?.pricePerNight ?? room.pricePerNight ?? 0;
  }

  // <--- Calcula el costo total para una habitaciÃ³n especÃ­fica
  calculateTotalPrice(room: RoomDtoResponse): number {
    return this.getRoomPrice(room) * this.calculateDays();
  }

  // <--- Pregunta antes de confirmar o cancelar
  selectRoomAndRedirect(room: RoomDtoResponse): void {
    const { checkIn, checkOut, guestCount } = this.availabilityForm.value;
    const pricePerNight = this.getRoomPrice(room);
    const days = this.calculateDays();
    const total = pricePerNight * days;

    const confirmationMessage = 
      `Â¿Desea confirmar la reserva de la HabitaciÃ³n #${room.number}?\n\n` +
      `EstadÃ­a: ${days} dÃ­a(s) (Del ${checkIn} al ${checkOut})\n` +
      `Total estimado: $${total.toFixed(2)}`;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(confirmationMessage);

    if (confirmed) {
      this.bookingStateService.setBookingData({
        checkIn,
        checkOut,
        guestCount,
        room,
        nights: days,
        totalPrice: total
      });
      this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/booking-create']);
    } else {
      console.log('SelecciÃ³n de habitaciÃ³n cancelada por el usuario.');
    }
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\booking-form\booking-form.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormBuilder, FormGroup, ReactiveFormsModule, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { BookingService } from '../../core/services/booking.service';
import { BookingStateService } from '../../core/services/booking-state.service';
import { UserDtoResponse } from '../../models/User-model';
import * as QRCode from 'qrcode';
import { BookingDtoResponse } from '../../models/Booking-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-booking-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './booking-form.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./booking-form.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class BookingFormComponent implements OnInit {
  bookingForm!: FormGroup;
  bookingData: any = null;
  
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  usersList = signal<UserDtoResponse[]>([]);
  isRegisteredUser = signal<boolean>(false);
  loading = signal<boolean>(false);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');

  constructor(
    private fb: FormBuilder,
    private bookingService: BookingService,
    private bookingStateService: BookingStateService,
    private http: HttpClient,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.bookingData = this.bookingStateService.getBookingData();

    if (!this.bookingData) {
      alert('No se ha seleccionado ninguna habitaciÃ³n previa.');
      this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/bookings/disponibilidad']);
      return;
    }

    this.initForm();
    this.loadUsers();
  }

  loadUsers(): void {
    this.http.get<UserDtoResponse[]>('http://localhost:8080/private/user', { withCredentials: true }).subscribe({
      next: (users: UserDtoResponse[]) => {
        this.usersList.set(Array.isArray(users) ? users : []);
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar la lista de usuarios', err);
        this.usersList.set([]);
      }
    });
  }

  initForm(): void {
    this.bookingForm = this.fb.group({
      isRegisteredUser: [false],
      userId: [null],
      guestFirstName: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2), Validators.maxLength(100)]],
      guestLastName: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2), Validators.maxLength(100)]],
      guestPhone: ['', [Validators.required]],
      observation: ['', [Validators.maxLength(250)]]
    });

    // Control dinÃ¡mico de validaciones mediante Signals
    this.bookingForm.get('isRegisteredUser')?.valueChanges.subscribe((isReg: boolean) => {
      this.isRegisteredUser.set(isReg);
      
      const firstNameCtrl = this.bookingForm.get('guestFirstName');
      const lastNameCtrl = this.bookingForm.get('guestLastName');
      const phoneCtrl = this.bookingForm.get('guestPhone');
      const userIdCtrl = this.bookingForm.get('userId');

      if (isReg) {
        firstNameCtrl?.clearValidators();
        lastNameCtrl?.clearValidators();
        phoneCtrl?.clearValidators();
        userIdCtrl?.setValidators([Validators.required]);
      } else {
        firstNameCtrl?.setValidators([Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2), Validators.maxLength(100)]);
        lastNameCtrl?.setValidators([Validators.required, Validators.minLength(2), Validators.maxLength(100)]);
        phoneCtrl?.setValidators([Validators.required]);
        userIdCtrl?.clearValidators();
        userIdCtrl?.setValue(null);
      }

      firstNameCtrl?.updateValueAndValidity();
      lastNameCtrl?.updateValueAndValidity();
      phoneCtrl?.updateValueAndValidity();
      userIdCtrl?.updateValueAndValidity();
    });
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.bookingForm.invalid) {
      this.bookingForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const formValues = this.bookingForm.value;

    let firstName = formValues.guestFirstName;
    let lastName = formValues.guestLastName;
    let phone = formValues.guestPhone;

    if (formValues.isRegisteredUser && formValues.userId) {
      const selectedUser = this.usersList().find(u => u.id === Number(formValues.userId));
      if (selectedUser) {
        firstName = selectedUser.name;
        lastName = selectedUser.surname;
        phone = selectedUser.phoneNumber || 'Sin telÃ©fono';
      }
    }

    const requestPayload = {
      checkIn: this.bookingData.checkIn,
      checkOut: this.bookingData.checkOut,
      guestCount: this.bookingData.guestCount,
      roomId: this.bookingData.room.id,
      userId: formValues.isRegisteredUser ? Number(formValues.userId) : null,
      guestFirstName: firstName,
      guestLastName: lastName,
      guestPhone: phone || 'Sin telÃ©fono',
      observation: formValues.observation || undefined,
      totalPrice: this.bookingData.totalPrice
    };

    this.bookingService.createBooking(requestPayload).subscribe({
      next: async (response: BookingDtoResponse) => {
        this.loading.set(false);

        // Si la API devuelve el token qrBooking, generamos y descargamos la imagen automÃ¡ticamente
        if (response.qrBooking) {
          try {
            const qrDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(response.qrBooking, {
              width: 300,
              margin: 2
            });

            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = qrDataUrl;
            link.download = `qr-reserva-${response.id}-${response.guestLastName}.png`;
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error al generar la imagen QR de la reserva', err);
          }
        }

        alert('Â¡Reserva creada con Ã©xito y cÃ³digo QR descargado!');
        this.bookingStateService.clear();
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/booking-list']);
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.loading.set(false);
        this.errorMessage.set(err.error?.message || 'Error al registrar la reserva en el sistema. Verifique los datos.');
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }
}

import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { BookingService } from '../../core/services/booking.service';
import { BookingDtoResponse } from '../../models/Booking-model';
import { PaymentDTOResponse } from '../../models/Payment-model'; 
import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service';
import { AccountService } from '../../core/services/account.service';
import * as QRCode from 'qrcode';

export interface BookingWithAccount extends BookingDtoResponse {
  hasAccount?: boolean;
  accountId?: number;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-booking-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './booking-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./booking-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class BookingListComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  bookings = signal<BookingWithAccount[]>([]);
  loading = signal<boolean>(true);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');
  canModify = signal<boolean>(false);

  // Bandera para rastrear quÃ© IDs estÃ¡n en proceso de cancelaciÃ³n y evitar doble envÃ­o
  cancellingIds = signal<number[]>([]);

  selectedBookingForPayment = signal<BookingDtoResponse | null>(null);
  bookingPayments = signal<PaymentDTOResponse[]>([]);
  loadingPayments = signal<boolean>(false);
  
  newPaymentAmount = signal<number | null>(null);
  newPaymentMethod = signal<string>('CASH');
  newPaymentReference = signal<string>('');

  constructor(
    private bookingService: BookingService,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private accountService: AccountService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRole();
    this.loadBookings();
  }

  checkUserRole(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role');
    if (storedRoles) {
      try {
        const roles = JSON.parse(storedRoles);
        if (Array.isArray(roles)) {
          const hasAccess = roles.some((r: any) => {
            const val = typeof r === 'string' ? r : (r.authority || '');
            return val === 'ADMIN' || val === 'ROLE_ADMIN' || val === 'RECEPCIONIST' || val === 'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST';
          });
          this.canModify.set(hasAccess);
        } else {
          const val = typeof roles === 'string' ? roles : '';
          this.canModify.set(val === 'ADMIN' || val === 'ROLE_ADMIN' || val === 'RECEPCIONIST' || val === 'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        this.canModify.set(storedRoles.includes('ADMIN') || storedRoles.includes('RECEPCIONIST'));
      }
    } else {
      this.canModify.set(false);
    }
  }

  loadBookings(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    
    this.bookingService.processNoShows().subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.fetchAndFilterBookings();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.warn('No se pudo ejecutar el procesamiento automÃ¡tico de No-Shows, continuando carga...', err);
        this.fetchAndFilterBookings();
      }
    });
  }

  activeTab = signal<'PENDING' | 'NO_SHOW'>('PENDING');

  private fetchAndFilterBookings(): void {
    this.bookingService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        const allBookings = Array.isArray(data) ? [...data] : [];
        
        const filtered: BookingWithAccount[] = allBookings.filter(
          (b) => b.state === 'PENDING' || b.state === 'CONFIRMED' || b.state === 'NO_SHOW'
        );
        
        this.bookings.set(filtered);
        this.loading.set(false);

        filtered.forEach((booking) => {
          this.accountService.getAccountByBookingId(booking.id).subscribe({
            next: (account: any) => {
              if (account && account.id) {
                booking.hasAccount = true;
                booking.accountId = account.id;
              } else {
                booking.hasAccount = false;
              }
              this.cdr.markForCheck();
            },
            error: () => {
              booking.hasAccount = false;
              this.cdr.markForCheck();
            }
          });
        });
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las reservas o no cuentas con los permisos necesarios.');
        this.loading.set(false);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  isCancelling(id: number): boolean {
    return this.cancellingIds().includes(id);
  }

  cancelBooking(id: number): void {
    console.log(`[DEBUG] Iniciando proceso de cancelaciÃ³n para la reserva ID: ${id}`);

    if (!this.canModify()) {
      console.warn('[DEBUG] AcciÃ³n bloqueada: El usuario no cuenta con permisos de modificaciÃ³n.');
      alert('No tienes los permisos necesarios para realizar esta acciÃ³n.');
      return;
    }

    // Evitar mÃºltiples peticiones paralelas para la misma reserva
    if (this.isCancelling(id)) {
      console.warn(`[DEBUG] La reserva ID ${id} ya se encuentra en proceso de cancelaciÃ³n.`);
      return;
    }

    const reason = prompt('Por favor, ingrese el motivo de la cancelaciÃ³n:');
    if (reason === null) {
      console.log('[DEBUG] CancelaciÃ³n abortada por el usuario (prompt cerrado o cancelado).');
      return;
    }

    if (!reason.trim()) {
      console.warn('[DEBUG] El motivo de cancelaciÃ³n ingresado estÃ¡ vacÃ­o.');
      alert('Debes ingresar un motivo vÃ¡lido.');
      return;
    }

    // Marcamos esta reserva como "en proceso de cancelaciÃ³n"
    this.cancellingIds.update(ids => [...ids, id]);
    console.log(`[DEBUG] Reserva ID ${id} agregada a cancellingIds. Consultando cuenta financiera...`);

    const userIdStr = localStorage.getItem('userId');
    const userId = userIdStr ? Number(userIdStr) : 1;
    console.log(`[DEBUG] ID de usuario recuperado para la cancelaciÃ³n: ${userId}`);

    // Consultamos la cuenta especÃ­fica de esta reserva
    this.accountService.getAccountByBookingId(id).subscribe({
      next: (account: any) => {
        console.log(`[DEBUG] Cuenta obtenida exitosamente para bookingId ${id}:`, account);
        
        const hasPayments = account && account.paidAmount > 0;
        let issueCreditNote = false;

        if (hasPayments) {
          console.log(`[DEBUG] La cuenta posee pagos registrados (paidAmount: ${account.paidAmount}). Consultando emisiÃ³n de nota de crÃ©dito...`);
          issueCreditNote = confirm('Esta reserva cuenta con pagos registrados. Â¿Desea emitir una nota de crÃ©dito/reintegro?');
        } else {
          console.log('[DEBUG] La cuenta no registra pagos previos. No se requiere nota de crÃ©dito.');
        }

        const request = {
          bookingId: id,
          reason: reason.trim(),
          userId: userId,
          issueCreditNote: issueCreditNote
        };

        console.log(`[DEBUG] Enviando peticiÃ³n final de cancelaciÃ³n (con cuenta) para bookingId ${id}:`, request);
        this.executeCancellation(request, id);
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.warn(`[DEBUG] No se pudo obtener la cuenta para la reserva ID ${id} (o no existe). Procediendo a cancelar sin cuenta...`, err);
        
        const request = {
          bookingId: id,
          reason: reason.trim(),
          userId: userId,
          issueCreditNote: false
        };

        console.log(`[DEBUG] Enviando peticiÃ³n final de cancelaciÃ³n (alternativa sin cuenta) para bookingId ${id}:`, request);
        this.executeCancellation(request, id);
      }
    });
  }

  private executeCancellation(request: any, id: number): void {
    this.bookingService.cancelBooking(request).subscribe({
      next: (response) => {
        console.log(`[DEBUG] Â¡CancelaciÃ³n exitosa en servidor para la reserva ID ${id}! Respuesta:`, response);
        alert(`Reserva ID ${id} cancelada exitosamente.`);
        this.cancellingIds.update(ids => ids.filter(item => item !== id));
        this.loadBookings();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error(`[DEBUG ERROR] FallÃ³ el servicio al intentar cancelar la reserva ID ${id}. Objeto de error HTTP:`, err);
        console.error(`[DEBUG ERROR] Status code: ${err.status}, Mensaje: ${err.message}, Body error:`, err.error);
        alert('Error al intentar cancelar la reserva.');
        this.cancellingIds.update(ids => ids.filter(item => item !== id));
      }
    });
  }

  confirmBooking(id: number): void {
    if (!this.canModify()) {
      alert('No tienes los permisos necesarios para realizar esta acciÃ³n.');
      return;
    }

    this.bookingService.confirmBooking(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        alert(`Reserva ID ${id} confirmada exitosamente.`);
        this.loadBookings();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        alert('Error al intentar confirmar la reserva.');
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  openPaymentModal(booking: BookingWithAccount): void {
    this.selectedBookingForPayment.set(booking);
    this.loadBookingPayments(booking.id);
  }

  closePaymentModal(): void {
    this.selectedBookingForPayment.set(null);
    this.bookingPayments.set([]);
    this.newPaymentAmount.set(null);
    this.newPaymentReference.set('');
  }

  loadBookingPayments(bookingId: number): void {
    this.loadingPayments.set(true);
    
    this.accountService.getPaymentsByBookingId(bookingId).subscribe({
      next: (payments) => {
        this.bookingPayments.set(Array.isArray(payments) ? payments : []);
        this.loadingPayments.set(false);
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar el historial de seÃ±as:', err);
        this.bookingPayments.set([]);
        this.loadingPayments.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  submitBookingPayment(): void {
    const booking = this.selectedBookingForPayment() as BookingWithAccount;
    const amount = this.newPaymentAmount();

    if (!booking || !amount || amount <= 0) {
      alert('Por favor, ingresa un monto vÃ¡lido.');
      return;
    }

    const bookingId = booking.id;
    const accountId = booking.accountId;

    if (!accountId) {
      alert('No se encontrÃ³ una cuenta asociada a esta reserva.');
      return;
    }

    const request = {
      accountId: accountId,
      amount: amount,
      paymentMethod: this.newPaymentMethod(),
      transactionReference: this.newPaymentReference().trim()
    };

    this.accountService.addPayment(request).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        alert('SeÃ±a registrada exitosamente.');
        this.loadBookingPayments(bookingId);
        this.newPaymentAmount.set(null);
        this.newPaymentReference.set('');
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        alert('Error al registrar la seÃ±a.');
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  // --- MÃ©todo para descargar el CÃ³digo QR desde la lista ---
  async downloadQr(booking: BookingDtoResponse): Promise<void> {
    if (!booking.qrBooking) {
      alert('Esta reserva no cuenta con un cÃ³digo QR generado.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const qrDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(booking.qrBooking, {
        width: 300,
        margin: 2
      });

      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = qrDataUrl;
      link.download = `qr-reserva-${booking.id}-${booking.guestLastName}.png`;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error al generar la imagen QR para la descarga', err);
      alert('No se pudo generar la imagen del cÃ³digo QR.');
    }
  }
}

            @if (booking.qrBooking && qrDataUrls()[booking.id]) {
              <div class="qr-box mb-3 text-center" style="background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.4); padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);">
                <span class="qr-label d-block mb-1" style="font-size: 0.75rem;">CÃ³digo QR Asociado:</span>
                <img [src]="qrDataUrls()[booking.id]" alt="QR Reserva #{{ booking.id }}" style="width: 90px; height: 90px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);" />
              </div>
            }

            @if (canModify()) {
              <button class="btn-primary w-100" (click)="goToCreateCheckIn(booking)">
                <i class="bi bi-check2-circle me-1"></i> Realizar Check-In
              </button>
            }
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- SECCIÃ“N INFERIOR: Tabla con las reservas en estado CHECKED_IN -->
  <section>
    <h3 class="section-title mb-3">EstadÃ­as Activas (Checked-In)</h3>

    @if (checkedInBookings().length === 0 && !loading()) {
      <p class="subtitle">No hay pasajeros con check-in activo actualmente.</p>
    }

    @if (checkedInBookings().length > 0) {
      <div class="table-wrapper">
        <table class="table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th class="ps-4">ID</th>
              <th>HuÃ©sped</th>
              <th>HabitaciÃ³n</th>
              <th>Check-In / Out</th>
              <th style="text-align: right; padding-right: 1.5rem;">Acciones</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (b of checkedInBookings(); track b.id) {
              <tr>
                <td class="ps-4"><strong>#{{ b.id }}</strong></td>
                <td>{{ b.guestFirstName }} {{ b.guestLastName }}</td>
                <td><span class="badge badge-secondary">Hab. #{{ b.roomNumber }}</span></td>
                <td class="subtitle">{{ b.checkIn }} al {{ b.checkOut }}</td>
                <td style="text-align: right; padding-right: 1.5rem;">
                  <div class="table-actions">
                    <button class="btn-secondary-action" (click)="servicesPlaceholder(b.id)" title="Servicios">
                      <i class="bi bi-bag-plus"></i>
                    </button>
                    <button class="btn-secondary-action" (click)="viewAccountPlaceholder(b.id)" title="Cuenta">
                      <i class="bi bi-wallet2"></i>
                    </button>
                    @if (canModify()) {
                      <button class="btn-danger" (click)="interruptStay(b.id)" title="Interrumpir">
                        <i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i>
                      </button>
                    }
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    }
  </section>

  <!-- MODAL / PANEL DE CHECK-IN TRADICIONAL -->
  @if (selectedBookingForCheckIn(); as booking) {
    <div class="modal-backdrop" (click)="selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null)">
      <div class="modal-card" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        
        <button type="button" class="btn-close" aria-label="Cerrar modal" (click)="selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null)">
          <i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i>
        </button>

        <div class="modal-header-profile">
          <h3>Check-In â€” Reserva #{{ booking.id }}</h3>
        </div>

        <div class="modal-body-content">
          @if (checkInSuccess()) {
            <div class="alert alert-success">{{ checkInSuccess() }}</div>
          }

          <!-- Selector de usuarios si no tiene uno asignado -->
          @if (showUserSelector() && !showNewUserForm() && !checkInSuccess()) {
            <div class="mb-3">
              <h6 class="text-warning mb-3">La reserva no tiene un usuario asociado. Seleccione uno:</h6>
              
              <div class="form-group">
                <label class="form-label">Usuario del Sistema:</label>
                <select class="form-control" [ngModel]="selectedUserId()" (ngModelChange)="selectedUserId.set($event)">
                    <option [ngValue]="null" disabled>-- Seleccione un usuario --</option>
                    @for (u of users(); track u.id) {
                    <option [ngValue]="u.id">
                        {{ u.name }} {{ u.surname }} ({{ u.email }})
                    </option>
                    }
                </select>
            </div>

              <button class="btn-primary w-100" [disabled]="!selectedUserId()" (click)="assignAndCheckIn()">
                Asociar y Registrar Check-In
              </button>
            </div>
          }

          @if (!showUserSelector() && !showNewUserForm() && !checkInSuccess()) {
            <p class="subtitle">Procesando check-in...</p>
          }

          <!-- Formulario para crear usuario si no existe -->
          @if (showNewUserForm()) {
            <div class="form-section pt-3">
              <h6 class="text-warning mb-3">Usuario no encontrado. Complete los datos:</h6>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="text" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().username" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('username', $event)" placeholder="Username"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="email" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().email" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('email', $event)" placeholder="Email"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="password" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().password" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('password', $event)" placeholder="Password"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="text" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().name" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('name', $event)" placeholder="Nombre"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="text" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().surname" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('surname', $event)" placeholder="Apellido"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="text" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().dni" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('dni', $event)" placeholder="DNI"></div>
              <div class="form-group mb-2"><input type="text" class="form-control" [ngModel]="newUser().phoneNumber" (ngModelChange)="updateNewUserField('phoneNumber', $event)" placeholder="TelÃ©fono"></div>
              
              <button class="btn-primary w-100 mt-2" (click)="createNewUserAndProceed()">Crear Usuario y Hacer Check-In</button>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  }

  <!-- MODAL DE ERROR UNIFICADO -->
  @if (checkInError() && !selectedBookingForCheckIn()) {
    <div class="modal-backdrop" (click)="checkInError.set('')">
      <div class="modal-card" style="max-width: 360px;" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        <div class="modal-header-profile border-bottom pb-2 mb-3">
          <h3 class="m-0 text-danger" style="font-size: 1.1rem;"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i> Aviso de Check-In</h3>
        </div>
        <p class="subtitle text-light mb-4">{{ checkInError() }}</p>
        <button class="btn-primary w-100" (click)="checkInError.set('')">Aceptar</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  }

</div>

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\check-in-list\check-in-list.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { CheckInService } from '../../core/services/check-in.service';
import { BookingDtoResponse } from '../../models/Booking-model';
import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service';
import { UserService } from '../../core/services/user.service';
import * as QRCode from 'qrcode';
// @ts-ignore
import jsQR from 'jsqr';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-check-in-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './check-in-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./check-in-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class CheckInListComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  pendingBookingsToday = signal<BookingDtoResponse[]>([]);
  checkedInBookings = signal<BookingDtoResponse[]>([]);

  loading = signal<boolean>(true);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');
  canModify = signal<boolean>(false);

  selectedBookingForCheckIn = signal<BookingDtoResponse | null>(null);
  inputDni = signal<string>('');
  
  users = signal<any[]>([]);
  selectedUserId = signal<number | null>(null);
  showUserSelector = signal<boolean>(false);
  
  showNewUserForm = signal<boolean>(false);
  newUser = signal({
    username: '', email: '', password: '', name: '', surname: '', dni: '', phoneNumber: ''
  });
  
  checkInError = signal<string>('');
  checkInSuccess = signal<string>('');

  // --- PROPIEDADES PARA LECTURA DE QR MEDIANTE ARCHIVO ---
  qrInputCode = signal<string>('');
  selectedBookingForQr = signal<BookingDtoResponse | null>(null);
  qrError = signal<string>('');
  qrSuccess = signal<string>('');

  // Mapa interno para almacenar las URLs de las miniaturas de QR por ID de reserva
  qrDataUrls = signal<{ [key: number]: string }>({});

  constructor(
    private checkInService: CheckInService,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private userService: UserService,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRole();
    this.loadData();
    this.loadUsers();
  }

  checkUserRole(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role');
    if (storedRoles) {
      try {
        const roles = JSON.parse(storedRoles);
        const hasAccess = Array.isArray(roles) 
          ? roles.some((r: any) => ['ADMIN', 'ROLE_ADMIN', 'RECEPCIONIST', 'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST'].includes(typeof r === 'string' ? r : r.authority))
          : ['ADMIN', 'ROLE_ADMIN', 'RECEPCIONIST', 'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST'].includes(storedRoles);
        this.canModify.set(hasAccess);
      } catch (e) {
        this.canModify.set(storedRoles.includes('ADMIN') || storedRoles.includes('RECEPCIONIST'));
      }
    }
  }

  loadData(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.checkInService.getTodayCheckIns().subscribe({
      next: (todayBookings) => {
        const filtered = Array.isArray(todayBookings) 
          ? todayBookings.filter(b => b.state === 'CONFIRMED' || b.state === 'PENDING') 
          : [];
        
        this.pendingBookingsToday.set(filtered);
        this.generateQrThumbnails(filtered);
        this.loadCheckedInBookings();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error('Error cargando reservas:', err);
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las reservas.');
        this.pendingBookingsToday.set([]);
        this.loadCheckedInBookings();
      }
    });
  }

  // Genera las miniaturas de QR en base64 para cada tarjeta
  private async generateQrThumbnails(bookings: BookingDtoResponse[]): Promise<void> {
    const map: { [key: number]: string } = {};
    for (const b of bookings) {
      if (b.qrBooking) {
        try {
          map[b.id] = await QRCode.toDataURL(b.qrBooking, { width: 120, margin: 1 });
        } catch (e) {
          console.error(`Error generando QR para reserva #${b.id}`, e);
        }
      }
    }
    this.qrDataUrls.set(map);
  }

  loadCheckedInBookings(): void {
    this.checkInService.getBookingsByState('CHECKED_IN').subscribe({
      next: (bookings) => {
        this.checkedInBookings.set(Array.isArray(bookings) ? bookings : []);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.checkedInBookings.set([]);
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  loadUsers(): void {
    this.userService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => { 
        this.users.set(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []); 
      },
      error: (err: any) => console.error('Error al cargar usuarios:', err)
    });
  }

  // --- GESTIÃ“N DE LECTURA QR MEDIANTE ADJUNTO DE IMAGEN PNG ---
  onQrFileSelected(event: any): void {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;

    this.qrError.set('');
    this.qrSuccess.set('');

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e: any) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!context) {
          this.qrError.set('No se pudo inicializar el contexto de lectura de imagen.');
          return;
        }

        canvas.width = img.width;
        canvas.height = img.height;
        context.drawImage(img, 0, 0, img.width, img.height);

        const imgData = context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const code = jsQR(imgData.data, imgData.width, imgData.height);

        if (code) {
          this.processDecodedQrCode(code.data);
        } else {
          this.qrError.set('No se pudo detectar un cÃ³digo QR vÃ¡lido en la imagen adjunta.');
        }
      };
      img.src = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    event.target.value = '';
  }

  private processDecodedQrCode(cleanCode: string): void {
    this.qrError.set('');
    this.qrSuccess.set('');

    const found = this.pendingBookingsToday().find(
      (b: any) => b.qrBooking === cleanCode
    );

    if (found) {
      // En vez de abrir un modal QR estÃ¡tico, disparamos directamente el flujo normal de Check-In
      // que valida el usuario asociado y abre el modal correspondiente si le falta.
      this.goToCreateCheckIn(found);
    } else {
      this.qrError.set('No se encontrÃ³ ninguna reserva activa para hoy con el cÃ³digo QR decodificado.');
    }
  }

  closeQrModal(): void {
    this.selectedBookingForQr.set(null);
    this.qrError.set('');
    this.qrSuccess.set('');
  }
  // ------------------------------------------

  goToCreateCheckIn(booking: BookingDtoResponse): void {
    if (!this.canModify()) return;

    this.selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(booking);
    this.inputDni.set(booking.guestPhone || '');
    this.showNewUserForm.set(false);
    this.checkInSuccess.set('');
    this.checkInError.set('');
    this.selectedUserId.set(null);

    const hasUser = !!booking.username;

    if (hasUser) {
      this.showUserSelector.set(false);
      this.executeCheckInDirectly(booking.id);
    } else {
      this.showUserSelector.set(true);
      this.checkInError.set("Please select a valid user before checking in.");
    }
  }

  executeCheckInDirectly(bookingId: number): void {
    this.checkInService.checkInBooking(bookingId).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.checkInSuccess.set('Â¡Check-in realizado con Ã©xito!');
        this.pendingBookingsToday.set(
          this.pendingBookingsToday().filter(b => b.id !== bookingId)
        );

        setTimeout(() => { 
          this.selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null); 
          this.loadData(); 
        }, 1200);
      },
      error: (err: any) => { 
        this.checkInError.set(err.error?.message || 'Error en el proceso de check-in.'); 
      }
    });
  }

  assignAndCheckIn(): void {
    const booking = this.selectedBookingForCheckIn();
    const userId = this.selectedUserId();

    if (!booking || !userId) {
      this.checkInError.set('Debe seleccionar un usuario.');
      return;
    }

    const bId = booking.id;
    this.checkInService.assignUserToBooking(bId, userId).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.checkInService.checkInBooking(bId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.checkInSuccess.set('Â¡Check-in y asociaciÃ³n realizados con Ã©xito!');
            this.pendingBookingsToday.set(
              this.pendingBookingsToday().filter(b => b.id !== bId)
            );
            setTimeout(() => { 
              this.selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null); 
              this.showUserSelector.set(false); 
              this.loadData(); 
            }, 1500);
          },
          error: (err: any) => {
            this.checkInError.set(err.error?.message || 'Error al hacer check-in tras asociar usuario.');
          }
        });
      },
      error: (err: any) => { 
        this.checkInError.set(err.error?.message || 'Error al asociar el usuario.'); 
      }
    });
  }

  submitCheckInWithDni(): void {
    const booking = this.selectedBookingForCheckIn();
    if (!booking) return;
    const bId = booking.id;

    this.checkInService.checkInBooking(bId, this.inputDni()).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.checkInSuccess.set('Â¡Check-in realizado con Ã©xito!');
        this.pendingBookingsToday.set(
          this.pendingBookingsToday().filter(b => b.id !== bId)
        );
        setTimeout(() => { 
          this.selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null); 
          this.loadData(); 
        }, 1200);
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        const errorMsg = err.error?.message || 'Error en proceso.';
        this.checkInError.set(errorMsg);
        if (errorMsg.includes('no user associated')) {
          this.showUserSelector.set(false);
          this.showNewUserForm.set(true);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  createNewUserAndProceed(): void {
    const booking = this.selectedBookingForCheckIn();
    if (!booking) return;
    const bId = booking.id;

    this.checkInService.createUser(this.newUser()).subscribe({
      next: (createdUser) => {
        this.checkInService.assignUserToBooking(bId, createdUser.id).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.checkInService.checkInBooking(bId, createdUser.dni).subscribe({
              next: () => {
                this.checkInSuccess.set('Â¡Check-in exitoso!');
                this.pendingBookingsToday.set(
                  this.pendingBookingsToday().filter(b => b.id !== bId)
                );
                setTimeout(() => { 
                  this.selectedBookingForCheckIn.set(null); 
                  this.showNewUserForm.set(false); 
                  this.loadData(); 
                }, 1500);
              }
            });
          }
        });
      },
      error: (err: any) => { 
        this.checkInError.set(err.error?.message || 'Error al crear usuario.'); 
      }
    });
  }

  updateNewUserField(field: string, value: any): void {
    this.newUser.update(u => ({ ...u, [field]: value }));
  }

  interruptStay(id: number): void {
    const reason = prompt('Motivo de interrupciÃ³n de estadÃ­a:');
    if (reason && reason.trim() !== '') {
      this.checkInService.interruptStay(id, reason).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          alert('EstadÃ­a interrumpida.');
          this.loadData();
        },
        error: (err: any) => alert(err.error?.message || 'Error al interrumpir.')
      });
    }
  }

  viewAccountPlaceholder(id: number): void { 
    this.router.navigate([`/dashboard/account-detail/${id}`]);
  }

  servicesPlaceholder(id: number): void { 
    console.log('ID de reserva recibido:', id);
    if (!id) {
      console.log('Â¡El ID es nulo o indefinido!');
      return;
    }
    this.router.navigate([`/dashboard/bookings/${id}/servicios`]);
  }
}

  <!-- Encabezado dinÃ¡mico -->

// ==========================================



import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators,
  AbstractControl,
  ValidationErrors
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';

import { CommentService } from '../../../core/services/comment.service';
import {
  CommentDtoRequest,
  CommentDtoResponse
} from '../../../models/Comment-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-comment-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule],
  templateUrl: './comment-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './comment-form.component.css'
})
export class CommentFormComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private commentService = inject(CommentService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);

  // Estados del componente
  isEditMode = signal(false);
  commentId = signal<number | null>(null);

  loading = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  // Formulario reactivo
  commentForm = this.fb.group({
    content: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.maxLength(500),
      this.noWhitespaceValidator
    ]],
    rating: [5, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(1),
      Validators.max(5)
    ]]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');

    if (idParam !== null) {
      const id = Number(idParam);

      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
        this.errorMessage.set('ID de comentario invÃ¡lido.');
        this.commentForm.disable();
        return;
      }

      this.isEditMode.set(true);
      this.commentId.set(id);
      this.loadCommentData(id);
    }
  }

  // Evitar comentarios formados solo por espacios
  noWhitespaceValidator(
    control: AbstractControl
  ): ValidationErrors | null {
    const value = control.value as string;

    return value.trim().length === 0
      ? { whitespace: true }
      : null;
  }

  // Cargar datos del comentario para editar
  loadCommentData(id: number): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    this.commentForm.disable();

    this.commentService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (comments: CommentDtoResponse[]) => {
        const comment = comments.find(c => c.id === id);

        if (comment) {
          this.commentForm.patchValue({
            content: comment.content,
            rating: comment.rating
          });

          this.commentForm.enable();
        } else {
          this.errorMessage.set('Comentario no encontrado.');
        }

        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar el comentario.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  // Crear o actualizar comentario
  saveComment(): void {
    if (
      this.commentForm.invalid ||
      this.loading() ||
      this.saving() ||
      this.commentForm.disabled
    ) {
      this.commentForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const formValue = this.commentForm.getRawValue();

    const payload: CommentDtoRequest = {
      content: formValue.content.trim(),
      rating: formValue.rating
    };

    const id = this.commentId();

    if (this.isEditMode()) {
      if (id === null) {
        this.errorMessage.set('ID de comentario invÃ¡lido.');
        this.saving.set(false);
        return;
      }

      this.commentService.update(id, payload).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.saving.set(false);
          this.router.navigate(['/comments']);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo actualizar el comentario.');
          this.saving.set(false);
        }
      });

    } else {
      this.commentService.create(payload).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.saving.set(false);
          this.router.navigate(['/comment-list']);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo crear el comentario.');
          this.saving.set(false);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // Volver al listado
  goBack(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/comments']);
  }
}

// ==========================================


import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

import { CommentService } from '../../../core/services/comment.service';
import { CommentDtoResponse } from '../../../models/Comment-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-comment-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './comment-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './comment-list.component.css'
})
export class CommentListComponent implements OnInit {

  private commentService = inject(CommentService);

  comments = signal<CommentDtoResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal(false);
  deletingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  isAdmin = signal(false);
  isGuest = signal(false);
  currentUsername = signal('');

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRoles();
    this.loadComments();
  }

  checkUserRoles(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role') || '';
    this.isAdmin.set(storedRoles.includes('ADMIN'));
    this.isGuest.set(storedRoles.includes('GUEST'));
    this.currentUsername.set(localStorage.getItem('username') || '');
  }

  loadComments(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.commentService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.comments.set(data);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los comentarios.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  getUserAvatarUrl(userId: number): string {
    return `http://localhost:8080/private/user/${userId}/profile-picture`;
  }

  canCreate(): boolean {
    return this.isAdmin() || this.isGuest();
  }

  canEdit(comment: CommentDtoResponse): boolean {
    return this.isAdmin() || (this.isGuest() && comment.username === this.currentUsername());
  }

  canDelete(): boolean {
    return this.isAdmin();
  }

  deleteComment(id: number): void {
    if (!this.canDelete() || this.deletingId() !== null) {
      return;
    }

    this.deletingId.set(id);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.commentService.deleteComment(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.comments.update(comments => comments.filter(comment => comment.id !== id));
        this.deletingId.set(null);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo eliminar el comentario.');
        this.deletingId.set(null);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\credit-note-list\credit-note-list.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { CreditNoteService } from '../../core/services/credit-note.service';
import { AccountService } from '../../core/services/account.service';

import { BookingCancellationDtoResponse } from '../../models/Booking-model';
import { forkJoin, of } from 'rxjs';
import { catchError, map } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { BookingService } from '../../core/services/booking.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-credit-note-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './credit-note-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./credit-note-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class CreditNoteListComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  creditNotes = signal<any[]>([]);
  allCreditNotesCache = signal<any[]>([]); // CachÃ© para preservar la lista completa al realizar bÃºsquedas
  loading = signal<boolean>(false);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');
  searchCode = signal<string>('');

  // --- Estados del Modal de Detalle con Signals ---
  showModal = signal<boolean>(false);
  loadingDetail = signal<boolean>(false);
  cancellationDetail = signal<BookingCancellationDtoResponse | null>(null);
  detailError = signal<string>('');
  selectedCreditNote = signal<any>(null);

  constructor(
    private creditNoteService: CreditNoteService,
    private accountService: AccountService,
    private bookingService: BookingService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadCreditNotes();
  }

  loadCreditNotes(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    
    this.creditNoteService.getAllCreditNotes().subscribe({
      next: (notes) => {
        console.log("Notas de crÃ©dito crudas del backend:", notes);
        
        if (!notes || notes.length === 0) {
          this.creditNotes.set([]);
          this.allCreditNotesCache.set([]);
          this.loading.set(false);
          return;
        }

        const accountRequests = notes.map(note => {
          const accountId = note.accountId;
          if (!accountId) return of(note);

          return this.accountService.getAccountById(accountId).pipe(
            map(account => {
              console.log(`Datos obtenidos para la cuenta ${accountId}:`, account);
              return {
                ...note,
                account: account 
              };
            }),
            catchError((err: HttpErrorResponse) => {
              console.error(`Error al buscar la cuenta ${accountId}:`, err);
              return of(note);
            })
          );
        });

        forkJoin(accountRequests).subscribe({
          next: (enrichedNotes) => {
            console.log("Notas de crÃ©dito enriquecidas finales:", enrichedNotes);
            this.creditNotes.set(enrichedNotes);
            this.allCreditNotesCache.set(enrichedNotes);
            this.loading.set(false);
          },
          error: (err: HttpErrorResponse) => {
            console.error('Error general en forkJoin:', err);
            this.creditNotes.set(notes);
            this.allCreditNotesCache.set(notes);
            this.loading.set(false);
          }
        });
      },
      error: (err: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar las notas de crÃ©dito:', err);
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las notas de crÃ©dito.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  onSearch(): void {
    const query = this.searchCode().trim().toLowerCase();
    const cache = this.allCreditNotesCache();

    if (!query) {
      this.creditNotes.set(cache);
      return;
    }
    
    const filtered = cache.filter(note => 
      String(note.id).includes(query) || 
      String(note.accountId).includes(query) ||
      String(note.account?.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      String(note.account?.surname || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      String(note.account?.dni || '').includes(query)
    );

    this.creditNotes.set(filtered);
  }

  viewDetail(id: number): void {
    console.log('Ver detalle de nota de crÃ©dito ID:', id);
    const note = this.creditNotes().find(n => n.id === id);
    if (!note) return;

    this.selectedCreditNote.set(note);
    this.showModal.set(true);
    this.loadingDetail.set(true);
    this.cancellationDetail.set(null);
    this.detailError.set('');

    const targetBookingId = note.account?.bookingId;
    if (!targetBookingId) {
      this.loadingDetail.set(false);
      this.detailError.set('La cuenta asociada no contiene un identificador de reserva (bookingId).');
      return;
    }

    this.bookingService.getCancellationHistory().subscribe({
      next: (history: BookingCancellationDtoResponse[]) => {
        const found = history.find(c => c.bookingId === targetBookingId);
        if (found) {
          this.cancellationDetail.set(found);
        } else {
          this.detailError.set(`No se encontrÃ³ un registro de cancelaciÃ³n vinculado a la reserva #${targetBookingId}.`);
        }
        this.loadingDetail.set(false);
      },
      error: (err: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        console.error('Error al obtener el historial de cancelaciones:', err);
        this.loadingDetail.set(false);
        this.detailError.set('Error de conexiÃ³n al intentar obtener los detalles de la cancelaciÃ³n.');
      }
    });
  }

  closeModal(): void {
    this.showModal.set(false);
    this.selectedCreditNote.set(null);
    this.cancellationDetail.set(null);
    this.detailError.set('');
  }
}

import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { EmployeeService } from '../../../core/services/employee.service';

import {
  EmployeeDtoRequest,
  EmployeeDtoResponse,
  ShiftType
} from '../../../models/Employee-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-employee-edit',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './employee-edit.component.html',
  styleUrl: './employee-edit.component.css'
})
export class EmployeeEditComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private employeeService = inject(EmployeeService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);

  employeeId = signal<number | null>(null);
  employee = signal<EmployeeDtoResponse | null>(null);

  loading = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  successMessage = signal('');

  readonly availableShifts: ShiftType[] = [
    'MORNING',
    'AFTERNOON',
    'NIGHT'
  ];

  employeeForm = this.fb.group({
    employeeNumber: [''],

    hireDate: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],

    shift: this.fb.control<ShiftType>('MORNING', [
      Validators.required
    ]),

    salary: [0, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(0.01)
    ]]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void { //Confirma id valido y carga empleado de interes
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    const id = Number(idParam);

    if (!idParam || !Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El ID del empleado no es vÃ¡lido.');
      return;
    }

    this.employeeId.set(id);
    this.loadEmployee(id);
  }

  loadEmployee(id: number): void { //consulta al backend y completa el formulario.
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.employeeService.getById(id).subscribe({
      next: (employee) => { //Si encuentra al empleado, lo modifica
        this.employee.set(employee);

        this.employeeForm.patchValue({
          employeeNumber: employee.employeeNumber ?? '',
          hireDate: employee.hireDate,
          shift: employee.shift,
          salary: employee.salary
        });

        this.loading.set(false);
      },

      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los datos del empleado.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.saving() || this.loading()) {
      return;
    }

    const id = this.employeeId();
    const currentEmployee = this.employee();

    if (id === null || currentEmployee === null) {
      this.errorMessage.set(
        'No se encontrÃ³ el empleado que desea editar.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (this.employeeForm.invalid) {
      this.employeeForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const formValue = this.employeeForm.getRawValue();

    const updatedEmployee: EmployeeDtoRequest = {
      userId: id,
      employeeNumber: formValue.employeeNumber || undefined,
      emergencyPhoneNumber:
        currentEmployee.emergencyPhoneNumber,
      hireDate: formValue.hireDate,
      shift: formValue.shift,
      salary: Number(formValue.salary)
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    this.successMessage.set('');

    this.employeeService.update(id, updatedEmployee).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.successMessage.set('Empleado actualizado correctamente.');
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/employee-list']);
      },

      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo actualizar el empleado.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ==========================================



import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { EmployeeService } from '../../../core/services/employee.service';

import {
  EmployeeCreateUnifiedDTO,
  RoleType,
  ShiftType
} from '../../../models/Employee-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-employee-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './employee-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './employee-form.component.css'
})
export class EmployeeFormComponent {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private employeeService = inject(EmployeeService);
  private router = inject(Router);

  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  fileError = signal('');

  selectedFile = signal<File | null>(null);

  availableRoles: RoleType[] = [
    'ADMIN',
    'RECEPCIONIST',
    'HOUSEKEEPING',
    'MAINTENANCE',
    'RELIEF_STAFF'
  ];

  availableShifts: ShiftType[] = [
    'MORNING',
    'AFTERNOON',
    'NIGHT'
  ];

  availableGenders: string[] = [
    'MASCULINO',
    'FEMENINO',
    'OTRO',
    'PREFIERO NO DECIR'
  ];

  private getTodayDate(): string {
    const today = new Date();

    const year = today.getFullYear();
    const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }

  employeeForm = this.fb.group({

    // Datos del usuario
    username: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],

    password: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],

    name: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.minLength(3),
      Validators.maxLength(50)
    ]],

    surname: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.minLength(3),
      Validators.maxLength(50)
    ]],

    dni: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.pattern(/^\d{7,10}$/)
    ]],

    gender: ['MASCULINO', [
      Validators.maxLength(20)
    ]],

    email: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.email
    ]],

    phoneNumber: ['', [
      Validators.maxLength(15)
    ]],

    address: ['', [
      Validators.maxLength(150)
    ]],

    birthDay: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],

    role: this.fb.control<RoleType>('RECEPCIONIST', [
      Validators.required
    ]),

    // Datos laborales
    employeeNumber: [''],

    emergencyPhoneNumber: [''],

    hireDate: [this.getTodayDate()],

    shift: this.fb.control<ShiftType>('MORNING'),

    salary: [0]

  });

  // Capturar y validar fotografÃ­a
  onFileSelected(event: Event): void {

    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];

    this.fileError.set('');
    this.selectedFile.set(null);

    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    const maxSizeInBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

    if (file.size > maxSizeInBytes) {
      const fileSizeMb = (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1);

      this.fileError.set(`La imagen pesa ${fileSizeMb} MB. El tamaÃ±o mÃ¡ximo permitido es de 2 MB.`);

      input.value = '';
      return;
    }

    this.selectedFile.set(file);
  }

  // Guardar empleado
  onSubmit(): void {

    if (this.employeeForm.invalid) {
      this.employeeForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    if (this.fileError()) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const formValue = this.employeeForm.getRawValue();

    // La fecha de nacimiento debe ser anterior a hoy
    if (formValue.birthDay >= this.getTodayDate()) {
      this.errorMessage.set('La fecha de nacimiento debe ser anterior a hoy.');
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const employee: EmployeeCreateUnifiedDTO = {

      // Datos del usuario
      username: formValue.username,
      password: formValue.password,
      name: formValue.name,
      surname: formValue.surname,
      dni: formValue.dni,

      gender: formValue.gender || undefined,

      email: formValue.email,

      phoneNumber: formValue.phoneNumber || undefined,
      address: formValue.address || undefined,

      birthDay: formValue.birthDay,
      role: formValue.role,

      profilePictureFile: this.selectedFile() || undefined,

      // Datos laborales
      employeeNumber: formValue.employeeNumber || undefined,

      emergencyPhoneNumber:
        formValue.emergencyPhoneNumber || undefined,

      hireDate: formValue.hireDate || this.getTodayDate(),

      shift: formValue.shift,
      salary: Number(formValue.salary)
    };

    this.employeeService.create(employee).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/employee-list']);
      },

      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo registrar el empleado. VerificÃ¡ que el DNI, email y nombre de usuario no estÃ©n registrados.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}
