import { Component, inject, OnInit, OnDestroy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { DecimalPipe } from '@angular/common';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';

import { EmployeeService } from '../../../core/services/employee.service';
import { UserService } from '../../../core/services/user.service';

import { EmployeeDtoResponse , ShiftType} from '../../../models/Employee-model';
import { UserDtoResponse } from '../../../models/User-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-employee-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, DecimalPipe, ReactiveFormsModule],
  templateUrl: './employee-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './employee-list.component.css'
})
export class EmployeeListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  private employeeService = inject(EmployeeService);
  private userService = inject(UserService);

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);

  employees = signal<EmployeeDtoResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  isAdmin = signal(false);

  selectedEmployee = signal<EmployeeDtoResponse | null>(null);
  selectedUser = signal<UserDtoResponse | null>(null);

  detailLoading = signal(false);
  detailError = signal('');

  employeeAvatars = signal<Record<number, string>>({});
  employeeRoles = signal<Record<number, string>>({});

  deletingId = signal<number | null>(null);

  defaultAvatar = 'assets/default-avatar.png';

  selectedEmployeeForShift = signal<EmployeeDtoResponse | null>(null);
  updatingShift = signal(false);
  shiftError = signal('');

  readonly availableShifts: ShiftType[] = [
    'MORNING',
    'AFTERNOON',
    'NIGHT'
  ];

  shiftForm = this.fb.group({
    shift: this.fb.control<ShiftType>('MORNING', [
      Validators.required
    ])
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRole(); //verifica si el usuario actual es administrador.
    this.loadEmployees(); //consulta los empleados al backend.
  }

  checkUserRole(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role'); //Busca una propiedad llamada role dentro del almacenamiento local del navegador. Puede contener un unico rol o varios roles en un arreglo

    if (!storedRoles) {
      this.isAdmin.set(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const roles = JSON.parse(storedRoles); 
      const roleList = Array.isArray(roles) ? roles : [roles]; //Si ya es un arreglo, lo conserva. Si no lo es, crea un arreglo con ese Ãºnico elemento.

      const admin = roleList.some((role: unknown) => { //some() devuelve true cuando al menos un elemento del arreglo cumple la condiciÃ³n.
        if (typeof role === 'string') {
          return role === 'ADMIN' || role === 'ROLE_ADMIN';
        }

        if (typeof role === 'object' && role !== null) {
          const data = role as Record<string, unknown>;
          return (
            data['authority'] === 'ADMIN' ||
            data['authority'] === 'ROLE_ADMIN' ||
            data['name'] === 'ADMIN' ||
            data['name'] === 'ROLE_ADMIN'
          );
        }

        return false;
      });

      this.isAdmin.set(admin);

    } catch {
      this.isAdmin.set(
        storedRoles === 'ADMIN' || storedRoles === 'ROLE_ADMIN'
      );
    }
  }

  loadEmployees(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.employeeService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        const employees = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];

        this.employees.set(employees);
        this.loading.set(false);

        employees.forEach(employee => {
          this.loadEmployeeAvatar(employee.id);  //Solicitudes asincronas
          this.loadEmployeeRole(employee.id);
        });
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los empleados o no tienes permisos.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  
private loadEmployeeRole(employeeId: number): void {
  this.userService.getById(employeeId).subscribe({
    next: (user) => {

      const roleNames = user.roles.map(role => role.name);

      const roles = roleNames.join(', ') || 'N/A';

      this.employeeRoles.update(currentRoles => ({
        ...currentRoles,
        [employeeId]: roles
      }));
    },
    error: () => {
      this.employeeRoles.update(currentRoles => ({
        ...currentRoles,
        [employeeId]: 'N/A'
      }));
    }
  });
}


  getEmployeeRole(employeeId: number): string {
    return this.employeeRoles()[employeeId] || 'Cargando...';
  }

  private loadEmployeeAvatar(employeeId: number): void {
    if (this.employeeAvatars()[employeeId]) {
      return;
    }

    this.userService.getProfilePicture(employeeId).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        this.employeeAvatars.update(avatars => ({
          ...avatars,
          [employeeId]: url
        }));
      },
      error: () => {
        this.employeeAvatars.update(avatars => ({
          ...avatars,
          [employeeId]: this.defaultAvatar
        }));
      }
    });
  }

  getEmployeeAvatarUrl(employeeId: number): string {
    return this.employeeAvatars()[employeeId] || this.defaultAvatar;
  }

  openEmployeeDetail(employee: EmployeeDtoResponse): void {
    this.selectedEmployee.set(employee);
    this.selectedUser.set(null);

    this.detailLoading.set(true);
    this.detailError.set('');

    this.userService.getById(employee.id).subscribe({
      next: (user) => {
        if (this.selectedEmployee()?.id !== employee.id) {
          return;
        }

        this.selectedUser.set(user);
        this.detailLoading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        if (this.selectedEmployee()?.id !== employee.id) {
          return;
        }
        this.detailError.set('No se pudo cargar la informaciÃ³n del usuario asociado.');
        this.detailLoading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  closeEmployeeDetail(): void {
    this.selectedEmployee.set(null);
    this.selectedUser.set(null);
    this.detailError.set('');
    this.detailLoading.set(false);
  }

  
openShiftForm(employee: EmployeeDtoResponse): void {
  if (!this.isAdmin() || this.updatingShift()) {
    return;
  }

  this.selectedEmployeeForShift.set(employee);
  this.shiftError.set('');

  this.shiftForm.reset({
    shift: employee.shift
  });
}

cancelShiftChange(): void {
  if (this.updatingShift()) {
    return;
  }

  this.selectedEmployeeForShift.set(null);
  this.shiftError.set('');
  this.shiftForm.reset();
}

saveShiftChange(): void {
  if (!this.isAdmin()) {
    this.shiftError.set(
      'No tienes permisos para cambiar el turno.'
    );
    return;
  }

  const employee = this.selectedEmployeeForShift();

  if (!employee || this.updatingShift()) {
    return;
  }

  if (this.shiftForm.invalid) {
    this.shiftForm.markAllAsTouched();
    return;
  }

  const nuevoShift = this.shiftForm.controls.shift.value;

  if (nuevoShift === employee.shift) {
    this.shiftError.set(
      'Debe seleccionar un turno diferente al actual.'
    );
    return;
  }

  this.updatingShift.set(true);
  this.shiftError.set('');

  this.employeeService.updateShift(
    employee.id,
    nuevoShift
  ).subscribe({
    next: (updatedEmployee) => {

      this.employees.update(employees =>
        employees.map(current =>
          current.id === updatedEmployee.id
            ? updatedEmployee
            : current
        )
      );

      if (this.selectedEmployee()?.id === updatedEmployee.id) {
        this.selectedEmployee.set(updatedEmployee);
      }

      this.updatingShift.set(false);
      this.selectedEmployeeForShift.set(null);
      this.shiftForm.reset();
    },

    error: () => {

      this.shiftError.set('No se pudo actualizar el turno del empleado.');
      this.updatingShift.set(false);
    }
  });
}


  deleteEmployee(id: number): void {
    if (!this.isAdmin()) {
      this.errorMessage.set('No tienes permisos para eliminar empleados.');
      return;
    }

    if (this.deletingId() !== null) {
      return;
    }

    this.deletingId.set(id);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.employeeService.delete(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.employees.update(employees =>
          employees.filter(employee => employee.id !== id)
        );

        const avatar = this.employeeAvatars()[id];

        if (avatar?.startsWith('blob:')) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(avatar);
        }

        this.employeeAvatars.update(avatars => {
          const updated = { ...avatars };
          delete updated[id];
          return updated;
        });

        this.employeeRoles.update(roles => {
          const updated = { ...roles };
          delete updated[id];
          return updated;
        });

        if (this.selectedEmployee()?.id === id) {
          this.closeEmployeeDetail();
        }

        if (this.selectedEmployeeForShift()?.id === id) {
          this.cancelShiftChange();
        }

        this.deletingId.set(null);
      },
      error: () => {

        this.errorMessage.set(
          'No se pudo eliminar el empleado.'
        );

        this.deletingId.set(null);
      }
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    Object.values(this.employeeAvatars()).forEach(url => {
      if (url.startsWith('blob:')) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }
    });
  }

}

import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { ItemService } from '../../../core/services/item.service';
import { ItemDtoRequest } from '../../../models/Item-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-item-edit',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './item-edit.component.html',
  styleUrl: './item-edit.component.css'
})
export class ItemEditComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private itemService = inject(ItemService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);

  loading = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  selectedImage = signal<File | null>(null);
  itemId = signal<number | null>(null);
  itemLoaded = signal(false);

  itemForm = this.fb.group({
    description: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],
    quantity: [1, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(1)
    ]],
    unitPrice: [0, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(0.01)
    ]],
    isService: [false]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    const id = Number(idParam);

    if (idParam === null || !Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El identificador del Ã­tem no es vÃ¡lido.');
      return;
    }

    this.itemId.set(id);
    this.loadItem(id);
  }

  loadItem(id: number): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    this.itemLoaded.set(false);

    this.itemService.getById(id).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.itemForm.patchValue({
          description: data.description,
          quantity: data.quantity,
          unitPrice: data.unitPrice,
          isService: data.isService ?? false
        });

        this.loading.set(false);
        this.itemLoaded.set(true);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los datos del Ã­tem.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  onImageSelected(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0] ?? null;

    this.selectedImage.set(file);
  }

  onSubmit(): void {

    if (!this.itemLoaded() || this.loading() || this.saving())  {
      return;
    }

    if (this.itemForm.invalid) {
      this.itemForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const id = this.itemId()!;
    const request: ItemDtoRequest = this.itemForm.getRawValue();
    const image = this.selectedImage() ?? undefined;

    this.itemService.updateItem(id, request, image).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/item-list']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo actualizar el Ã­tem.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { ItemService } from '../../../core/services/item.service';
import { ItemDtoRequest } from '../../../models/Item-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-item-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './item-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './item-form.component.css'
})
export class ItemFormComponent {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private itemService = inject(ItemService);
  private router = inject(Router);

  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  selectedImage = signal<File | null>(null);

  itemForm = this.fb.group({
    description: ['', [
      Validators.required
    ]],
    quantity: [1, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(1)
    ]],
    unitPrice: [0, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(0.01)
    ]],
    isService: [false]
  });

  onImageSelected(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0] ?? null;

    this.selectedImage.set(file);
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.itemForm.invalid) {
      this.itemForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    if (this.saving()) return;

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const request: ItemDtoRequest = this.itemForm.getRawValue();

    const image = this.selectedImage() ?? undefined;

    this.itemService.createItem(request, image).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['dashboard/item-list']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo crear el Ã­tem.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ==========================================



import { Component, inject, OnInit, OnDestroy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { ItemService } from '../../../core/services/item.service';
import { ItemDtoResponse } from '../../../models/Item-model';
import { CurrencyPipe } from '@angular/common';

interface ItemWithImage extends ItemDtoResponse {
  imageUrl?: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-item-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, CurrencyPipe],
  templateUrl: './item-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './item-list.component.css'
})
export class ItemListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  private itemService = inject(ItemService);

  items = signal<ItemWithImage[]>([]);

  loading = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  deletingId = signal<number | null>(null);

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadItems();
  }

  loadItems(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.clearImages();
    this.items.set([]);

    this.itemService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.items.set(data);
        this.loading.set(false);

        data.forEach(item => {
          this.loadItemImage(item.id);
        });
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los Ã­tems.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  //Obtiene la imagen de cada Ã­tem y genera una URL temporal para mostrarla
  loadItemImage(id: number): void {
    this.itemService.getItemImage(id).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        if (blob.size === 0) return;

        const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        const itemExists = this.items().some(item => item.id === id);

        if (!itemExists) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
          return;
        }

        this.items.update(items =>
          items.map(item =>
            item.id === id
              ? { ...item, imageUrl }
              : item
          )
        );
      },
      error: () => {
        // Un Ã­tem puede no tener imagen.
      }
    });
  }

  //elimina un registro y actualiza el listado solamente cuando el backend confirma la operaciÃ³n
  deleteItem(id: number): void {
    if (this.deletingId() !== null) return;

    this.deletingId.set(id);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.itemService.deleteItem(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        const deletedItem = this.items().find(item => item.id === id);

        if (deletedItem?.imageUrl) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(deletedItem.imageUrl);
        }

        this.items.update(items =>
          items.filter(item => item.id !== id)
        );

        this.deletingId.set(null);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo eliminar el Ã­tem.');
        this.deletingId.set(null);
      }
    });
  }

  private clearImages(): void {
    this.items().forEach(item => {
      if (item.imageUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(item.imageUrl);
      }
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.clearImages();
  }
}

// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectionStrategy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { PaymentService } from '../../core/services/payment.service';
import { AccountService } from '../../core/services/account.service';
import { PaymentDTOResponse } from '../../models/Payment-model';

// Interfaz extendida para incluir los datos del huÃ©sped de forma limpia
export interface PaymentWithGuest extends PaymentDTOResponse {
  guestName?: string;
  guestSurname?: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-payment-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './payment-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./payment-list.component.css'],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
})
export class PaymentListComponent implements OnInit {
  // --- Estados con Signals ---
  payments = signal<PaymentWithGuest[]>([]);
  loading = signal<boolean>(true);
  errorMessage = signal<string>('');

  constructor(
    private paymentService: PaymentService,
    private accountService: AccountService
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadPayments();
  }

  loadPayments(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');
    
    this.paymentService.getAllPayments().subscribe({
      next: (data: PaymentDTOResponse[]) => {
        const rawPayments: PaymentWithGuest[] = Array.isArray(data) ? [...data] : [];
        this.payments.set(rawPayments);
        this.loading.set(false);

        // Recorremos cada pago para buscar los datos del titular usando el accountId
        rawPayments.forEach(payment => {
          if (payment.accountId) {
            this.accountService.getAccountById(payment.accountId).subscribe({
              next: (account: any) => {
                if (account) {
                  payment.guestName = account.user?.name || account.name || '';
                  payment.guestSurname = account.user?.surname || account.surname || '';
                  // Actualizamos la seÃ±al con el array modificado para que OnPush detecte el cambio reactivamente
                  this.payments.set([...rawPayments]);
                }
              },
              error: (err) => console.error(`Error al cargar cuenta #${payment.accountId}`, err)
            });
          }
        });
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los pagos o no cuentas con los permisos necesarios.');
        this.loading.set(false);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ==========================================



import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { RoomService } from '../../../core/services/room.service';
import { RoomTypeService } from '../../../core/services/room-type.service';
import { RoomTypeDTOResponse } from '../../../models/RoomType-model';
import { RoomDtoResponse } from '../../../models/Room-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-edit',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './room-edit.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-edit.component.css'
})
export class RoomEditComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private roomService = inject(RoomService);
  private roomTypeService = inject(RoomTypeService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);

  roomId = 0;

  roomTypes = signal<RoomTypeDTOResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal(true);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  roomForm = this.fb.group({
    number: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    roomTypeId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const id = Number(this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')); //Captura de id de la pagina

    if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
      this.errorMessage.set('El ID de la habitaciÃ³n no es vÃ¡lido.');
      this.loading.set(false);
      return;
    }

    this.roomId = id;
    this.loadRoomData();
  }

  loadRoomData(): void { //Obtiene valores actuales de la habitacion
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomService.getById(this.roomId).subscribe({
      next: (room: RoomDtoResponse) => {

        this.roomForm.patchValue({
          number: Number(room.number),
          roomTypeId: room.roomTypeDTOResponse?.id ?? 0
        });

        this.loadRoomTypes();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar la habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  loadRoomTypes(): void {
    this.roomTypeService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.roomTypes.set(data);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los tipos de habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  updateRoom(): void {
    if (this.roomForm.invalid || this.saving() || this.loading()) {
      this.roomForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const request = this.roomForm.getRawValue();

    this.roomService.updateRoom(this.roomId, request).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/room-list']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo actualizar la habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\room\room-form\room-form.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators
} from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router'; // 1. Importar ActivatedRoute

import { RoomService } from '../../../core/services/room.service';
import { RoomTypeService } from '../../../core/services/room-type.service';
import { RoomTypeDTOResponse } from '../../../models/RoomType-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './room-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-form.component.css'
})
export class RoomFormComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private roomService = inject(RoomService);
  private roomTypeService = inject(RoomTypeService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute); // 2. Inyectar ActivatedRoute

  roomTypes = signal<RoomTypeDTOResponse[]>([]);
  selectedImages = signal<File[]>([]);

  loadingTypes = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  roomForm = this.fb.group({
    number: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    roomTypeId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    state: ['AVAILABLE', Validators.required]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRoomTypes();
  }

  loadRoomTypes(): void {
    this.loadingTypes.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomTypeService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.roomTypes.set(data);
        this.loadingTypes.set(false);

        // 3. Capturar el parÃ¡metro de la URL y asignarlo al formulario
        const typeIdParam = this.route.snapshot.queryParamMap.get('roomTypeId');
        if (typeIdParam) {
          const parsedId = Number(typeIdParam);
          // Opcional: Validar que el tipo exista en la lista cargada
          this.roomForm.patchValue({ roomTypeId: parsedId });
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los tipos de habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.loadingTypes.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  // Resto de tus mÃ©todos (onImagesSelected, createRoom, etc.) sin cambios...
  onImagesSelected(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    this.selectedImages.set(Array.from(input.files ?? []));
  }

  createRoom(): void {
    if (this.roomForm.invalid || this.saving()) {
      this.roomForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const request = this.roomForm.getRawValue();

    this.roomService.createRoom(
      request,
      this.selectedImages()
    ).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/room-list']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo crear la habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ==========================================


import { Component, inject, OnInit, OnDestroy, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { forkJoin, Subscription } from 'rxjs';

import { RoomService } from '../../../core/services/room.service';
import { RoomTypeService } from '../../../core/services/room-type.service';
import { RoomDtoResponse } from '../../../models/Room-model';
import { RoomTypeDTOResponse } from '../../../models/RoomType-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './room-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-list.component.css'
})
export class RoomListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  private roomService = inject(RoomService);
  private roomTypeService = inject(RoomTypeService);
  private route = inject(Router);

  rooms = signal<RoomDtoResponse[]>([]);
  roomTypes = signal<RoomTypeDTOResponse[]>([]); // SeÃ±al para los tipos de habitaciÃ³n
  loading = signal(true);
  errorMessage = signal(''); // Para errores al cargar habitaciones
  actionError = signal(''); // Para errores al eliminar o actualizar habitaciones

  selectedRoom = signal<RoomDtoResponse | null>(null);

  // SeÃ±ales del proceso de carga de imagenes
  roomImages = signal<string[]>([]);
  loadingImages = signal(false);
  imageError = signal('');
  currentImageIndex = signal(0);

  private imageSubscription?: Subscription;

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRooms();
    this.loadRoomTypes(); // Cargamos los tipos de habitaciÃ³n al iniciar
  }

  loadRooms(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.rooms.set(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar las habitaciones.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  loadRoomTypes(): void {
    this.roomTypeService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.roomTypes.set(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      },
      error: () => {
        // Manejo opcional de error para tipos de habitaciÃ³n
        console.error('No se pudieron cargar los tipos de habitaciÃ³n.');
      }
    });
  }

  deleteRoom(id: number): void {
    this.actionError.set('');

    this.roomService.deleteRoom(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.rooms.update(rooms =>
          rooms.filter(room => room.id !== id)
        );
      },
      error: () => {
        this.actionError.set('No se pudo eliminar la habitaciÃ³n.');
      }
    });
  }

  putInMaintenance(id: number): void {
    this.actionError.set('');

    this.roomService.putInMaintenance(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.rooms.update(rooms =>
          rooms.map(room =>
            room.id === id
              ? { ...room, state: 'MAINTENANCE' }
              : room
          )
        );

        if (this.selectedRoom()?.id === id) {
          this.selectedRoom.update(room =>
            room ? { ...room, state: 'MAINTENANCE' } : null
          );
        }
      },
      error: () => {
        this.actionError.set('No se pudo cambiar el estado de la habitaciÃ³n.');
      }
    });
  }

  openRoomModal(room: RoomDtoResponse): void {
    this.closeRoomModal(); 
    this.selectedRoom.set(room); 
    this.loadRoomImages(room); 
  }

  loadRoomImages(room: RoomDtoResponse): void {
    const count = room.imagesCount ?? 0;

    this.loadingImages.set(count > 0);
    this.imageError.set('');
    this.currentImageIndex.set(0);

    if (count === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const requests = Array.from(
      { length: count },
      (_, index) => this.roomService.getRoomImage(room.id, index)
    );

    this.imageSubscription = forkJoin(requests).subscribe({
      next: (blobs) => {
        if (this.selectedRoom()?.id !== room.id) {
          return;
        }

        const urls = blobs.map(blob => URL.createObjectURL(blob));

        this.roomImages.set(urls);
        this.loadingImages.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        if (this.selectedRoom()?.id === room.id) {
          this.imageError.set('No se pudieron cargar las imÃ¡genes.');
          this.loadingImages.set(false);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  previousImage(): void {
    const total = this.roomImages().length;

    if (total === 0) return;

    this.currentImageIndex.update(index =>
      (index - 1 + total) % total
    );
  }

  nextImage(): void {
    const total = this.roomImages().length;

    if (total === 0) return;

    this.currentImageIndex.update(index =>
      (index + 1) % total
    );
  }

  closeRoomModal(): void {
    this.imageSubscription?.unsubscribe();
    this.imageSubscription = undefined;

    this.roomImages().forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));

    this.roomImages.set([]);
    this.selectedRoom.set(null);
    this.loadingImages.set(false);
    this.imageError.set('');
    this.currentImageIndex.set(0);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.closeRoomModal();
  }

  nuevaHabitacion(roomTypeId?: number): void {
    if (roomTypeId) {
      this.route.navigate(['/dashboard/room-form'], { 
        queryParams: { roomTypeId } 
      });
    } else {
      this.route.navigate(['/dashboard/room-form']);
    }
  }

}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\room\room-type-form\room-type-form.component.ts 
// ==========================================



import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import {ReactiveFormsModule, NonNullableFormBuilder, Validators} from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { RoomTypeService } from '../../../core/services/room-type.service';
import { RoomTypeDTORequest } from '../../../models/RoomType-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-type-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './room-type-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-type-form.component.css'
})
export class RoomTypeFormComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private roomTypeService = inject(RoomTypeService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);

  isEditMode = signal(false);
  roomTypeId = signal<number | null>(null);

  loading = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');
  loadError = signal(false);

  roomTypeForm = this.fb.group({
    name: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.minLength(1),
      Validators.maxLength(50)
    ]],
    capacity: [1, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(1)
    ]],
    description: ['', [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.maxLength(250)
    ]],
    pricePerNight: [0, [
      Validators.required,
      Validators.min(0.01)
    ]]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void { //Detecta si se debe crear o editar un tipo de habitacion
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');

    if (idParam !== null) {
      const id = Number(idParam);

      if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
        this.errorMessage.set('El ID del tipo de habitaciÃ³n no es vÃ¡lido.');
        this.loadError.set(true);
        return;
      }

      this.isEditMode.set(true);
      this.roomTypeId.set(id);
      this.loadRoomTypeData(id);
    }
  }

  loadRoomTypeData(id: number): void { //Carga datos de habitacion y crea formulario para su edicion
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.loadError.set(false);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomTypeService.getById(id).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.roomTypeForm.patchValue({
          name: data.name,
          capacity: data.capacity,
          description: data.description ?? '',
          pricePerNight: data.pricePerNight
        });

        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo cargar la informaciÃ³n del tipo de habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.loadError.set(true);
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.roomTypeForm.invalid || this.saving() ||
        this.loading() || this.loadError()) {
      this.roomTypeForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    const request: RoomTypeDTORequest = this.roomTypeForm.getRawValue();

    const id = this.roomTypeId();

    if (this.isEditMode() && id !== null) { //Modo edicion
      this.roomTypeService.updateRoomType(id, request).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.saving.set(false);
          this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/room-type-list']);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo actualizar el tipo de habitaciÃ³n.');
          this.saving.set(false);
        }
      });
    } else { //Modo creacion
      this.roomTypeService.createRoomType(request).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.saving.set(false);
          this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/room-list']);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.errorMessage.set('No se pudo crear el tipo de habitaciÃ³n. VerificÃ¡ que el nombre no exista previamente.');
          this.saving.set(false);
        }
      });
    }
  }
}

import { Component, inject, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';

import { RoomTypeService } from '../../../core/services/room-type.service';
import { RoomTypeDTOResponse } from '../../../models/RoomType-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-type-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './room-type-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-type-list.component.css'
})
export class RoomTypeListComponent implements OnInit {

  private roomTypeService = inject(RoomTypeService);

  roomTypes = signal<RoomTypeDTOResponse[]>([]);
  loading = signal(true);
  errorMessage = signal(''); //Para errores al obtener tipos
  actionError = signal(''); //Para errores al eliminar tipos

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadRoomTypes();
  }

  loadRoomTypes(): void {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomTypeService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.roomTypes.set(data);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('No se pudieron cargar los tipos de habitaciÃ³n.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  deleteRoomType(id: number): void {
    this.actionError.set('');

    this.roomTypeService.deleteRoomType(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.roomTypes.update(types =>types.filter(type => type.id !== id));
      },
      error: () => {
        this.actionError.set('No se pudo eliminar el tipo de habitaciÃ³n.');
      }
    });
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\room-attention\room-attention-form\room-attention-form.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import {
  Component,
  OnInit,
  inject,
  signal
} from '@angular/core';

import {
  ReactiveFormsModule,
  NonNullableFormBuilder,
  Validators,
  FormsModule
} from '@angular/forms';

import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';

import { RoomAttentionService } from '../../../core/services/room-attention.service';
import { ItemService } from '../../../core/services/item.service';

import { RoomAttentionDtoRequest } from '../../../models/RoomAttention-model';
import { ItemDtoResponse } from '../../../models/Item-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-attention-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [ReactiveFormsModule, FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './room-attention-form.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-attention-form.component.css'
})
export class RoomAttentionFormComponent implements OnInit {

  private fb = inject(NonNullableFormBuilder);
  private roomAttentionService = inject(RoomAttentionService);
  private itemService = inject(ItemService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);

  bookingId = signal<number | null>(null);

  availableItems = signal<ItemDtoResponse[]>([]);

  loadingItems = signal(false);
  saving = signal(false);
  errorMessage = signal('');

  attentionForm = this.fb.group({
    itemId: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]],
    quantity: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(1)]]
  });

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // CORREGIDO: Cambiado de 'bookingId' a 'id' para que coincida con la ruta (:id)
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    const id = Number(idParam);

    if (idParam && Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0) {
      this.bookingId.set(id);
      this.loadAvailableItems();
    } else {
      this.errorMessage.set('ID de reserva no vÃ¡lido.');
    }
  }

  // Obtiene catÃ¡logo de productos y servicios
  loadAvailableItems(): void {
    this.loadingItems.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.itemService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (items) => {
        this.availableItems.set(items);
        this.loadingItems.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al cargar el catÃ¡logo de productos y servicios.');
        this.loadingItems.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  // Busca el producto seleccionado
  getSelectedItem(): ItemDtoResponse | undefined {
    const itemId = this.attentionForm.controls.itemId.value;
    return this.availableItems().find(item => item.id === itemId);
  }

  calculateSubtotal(): number {
    const selectedItem = this.getSelectedItem();

    if (!selectedItem) {
      return 0;
    }

    const quantity = this.attentionForm.controls.quantity.value;
    return selectedItem.unitPrice * quantity;
  }

  // Registra un producto o servicio consumido por un huÃ©sped durante su reserva
  onSubmit(): void {
    if (this.attentionForm.invalid) {
      this.attentionForm.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const id = this.bookingId();

    if (id === null || this.saving()) {
      return;
    }

    const formValue = this.attentionForm.getRawValue();

    const request: RoomAttentionDtoRequest = {
      bookingId: id,
      itemId: formValue.itemId,
      quantity: formValue.quantity
    };

    this.saving.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomAttentionService.addAttention(request).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.saving.set(false);
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/bookings', id, 'servicios']);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al registrar el consumo o servicio.');
        this.saving.set(false);
      }
    });
  }
}

      <i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat spin me-2"></i> Cargando consumos...
    </div>
  } @else {
    @if (attentions().length === 0) {

      </div>
    } @else {

        <div class="table-responsive">
          <table class="table-glass">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>ID</th>
                <th>DescripciÃ³n</th>
                <th>Cantidad</th>
                <th>Precio Unitario</th>
                <th>Subtotal</th>
                <th>Estado</th>
                @if (canModify()) {
                  <th class="text-end">Acciones</th>
                }
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (item of attentions(); track item.id) {
                <tr>
                  <td><strong class="text-subtitle">#{{ item.id }}</strong></td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="text-main fw-medium">
                    {{ $any(item).description || $any(item).itemName || $any(item).name || $any(item).title || 'Consumo #' + item.id }}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="text-main">{{ item.quantity }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="text-main">${{ item.unitPrice | number:'1.2-2' }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span class="text-main fw-bold text-success">${{ item.subtotal | number:'1.2-2' }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    @if (item.delivered) {
                      <span class="badge badge-success-glass">
                        <i class="bi bi-check-circle me-1"></i> Entregado
                      </span>
                    } @else {
                      <span class="badge badge-warning-glass">
                        <i class="bi bi-clock me-1"></i> Pendiente
                      </span>
                    }
                  </td>
                  
                  <!-- Acciones restringidas -->
                  @if (canModify()) {
                    <td class="text-end">
                      <div class="d-flex justify-content-end gap-2">
                        @if (!item.delivered) {
                          <button 
                            type="button"
                            class="btn-secondary-action" 
                            [disabled]="deliveringId() === item.id"
                            (click)="markAsDelivered(item.id)">
                            <i class="bi bi-check2-all me-1"></i> Entregar
                          </button>
                        }
                        <button 
                          type="button"
                          class="btn-danger-action" 
                          [disabled]="deletingId() === item.id"
                          (click)="deleteAttention(item.id)">
                          <i class="bi bi-trash me-1"></i> Eliminar
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  }
                </tr>
              }
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Resumen de Total -->
      <div class="total-section">
        <h3>Total consumos: <span class="text-success">${{ total() | number:'1.2-2' }}</span></h3>
      </div>
    }
  }

  <!-- BotÃ³n Volver -->
  <div class="mt-4">
    <a routerLink="/dashboard/check-in-list" class="btn-secondary-action">
      <i class="bi bi-arrow-left me-1"></i> Volver a Check-ins

import { Component, OnInit, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';

import { RoomAttentionService } from '../../../core/services/room-attention.service';
import { RoomAttentionDtoResponse } from '../../../models/RoomAttention-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-room-attention-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [RouterLink, CommonModule],
  templateUrl: './room-attention-list.component.html',
  styleUrl: './room-attention-list.component.css'
})
export class RoomAttentionListComponent implements OnInit {

  private roomAttentionService = inject(RoomAttentionService);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);

  bookingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  attentions = signal<RoomAttentionDtoResponse[]>([]);

  loading = signal<boolean>(false);
  deletingId = signal<number | null>(null);
  deliveringId = signal<number | null>(null);

  errorMessage = signal<string>('');
  canModify = signal<boolean>(false);

  total = computed(() =>
    this.attentions().reduce(
      (acc, attention) => acc + (attention.subtotal || 0),
      0
    )
  );

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRole();

    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    const id = Number(idParam);

    if (idParam && Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0) {
      this.bookingId.set(id);
      this.loadAttentions();
    } else {
      this.errorMessage.set('ID de reserva no vÃ¡lido.');
    }
  }

  checkUserRole(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role');

    if (!storedRoles) {
      this.canModify.set(false);
      return;
    }

    let roles: unknown;

    try {
      roles = JSON.parse(storedRoles);
    } catch {
      roles = storedRoles;
    }

    const roleList = Array.isArray(roles) ? roles : [roles];

    const allowed = roleList.some((role: unknown) => {
      let value = '';

      if (typeof role === 'string') {
        value = role;
      } else if (role && typeof role === 'object' && 'authority' in role) {
        value = String((role as any).authority);
      }

      return [
        'ADMIN',
        'ROLE_ADMIN',
        'RECEPCIONIST',
        'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST'
      ].includes(value);
    });

    this.canModify.set(allowed);
  }

  loadAttentions(): void {
    const id = this.bookingId();

    if (id === null) return;

    this.loading.set(true);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomAttentionService.getByBooking(id).subscribe({
      next: (data: RoomAttentionDtoResponse[]) => {
        this.attentions.set(data);
        this.loading.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al cargar los consumos de la reserva.');
        this.loading.set(false);
      }
    });
  }

  deleteAttention(id: number): void {
    if (!this.canModify() || this.deletingId() !== null) return;

    this.deletingId.set(id);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomAttentionService.deleteAttention(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.attentions.update(attentions =>
          attentions.filter(attention => attention.id !== id)
        );
        this.deletingId.set(null);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al eliminar el consumo.');
        this.deletingId.set(null);
      }
    });
  }

  markAsDelivered(id: number): void {
    if (!this.canModify() || this.deliveringId() !== null) return;

    this.deliveringId.set(id);
    this.errorMessage.set('');

    this.roomAttentionService.markAsDelivered(id).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.deliveringId.set(null);
        this.loadAttentions();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.errorMessage.set('Error al marcar el consumo como entregado.');
        this.deliveringId.set(null);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ==========================================


import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { UserService } from '../../core/services/user.service';
import { RoleType, UserDtoRequest } from '../../models/User-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-user-edit',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './user-edit.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['../user-form/user-form.component.css'] // Reutilizamos los estilos del formulario de creaciÃ³n
})
export class UserEditComponent implements OnInit {
  userId: number | null = null;

  formData = {
    username: '',
    name: '',
    surname: '',
    dni: '',
    gender: '',
    email: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    address: '',
    birthDay: '',
    profilePictureFile: undefined as File | undefined,
    role: 'GUEST' as RoleType,
    enabled: true
  };

  loading = false;
  errorMessage = '';

  constructor(
    private userService: UserService,
    private router: Router,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    const idParam = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (idParam) {
      this.userId = Number(idParam);
      this.loadUserData(this.userId);
    }
  }

  loadUserData(id: number): void {
    this.loading = true;
    this.userService.getById(id).subscribe({
      next: (user: any) => {
        this.formData.username = user.username || '';
        this.formData.name = user.name || '';
        this.formData.surname = user.surname || '';
        this.formData.dni = user.dni || '';
        this.formData.gender = user.gender || '';
        this.formData.email = user.email || '';
        this.formData.phoneNumber = user.phoneNumber || '';
        this.formData.address = user.address || '';
        this.formData.birthDay = user.birthDay || '';
        this.formData.role = user.role || 'GUEST';
        this.formData.enabled = user.enabled ?? true;

        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.loading = false;
        this.errorMessage = 'No se pudieron cargar los datos del usuario.';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  onFileSelected(event: any): void {
    const file: File = event.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      this.formData.profilePictureFile = file;
    }
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    if (!this.userId) return;

    this.errorMessage = '';
    this.loading = true;

    // Usamos el DTO de modificaciÃ³n que no requiere password
    const updatePayload = {
      username: this.formData.username,
      name: this.formData.name,
      surname: this.formData.surname,
      dni: this.formData.dni,
      gender: this.formData.gender || undefined,
      email: this.formData.email,
      phoneNumber: this.formData.phoneNumber || undefined,
      address: this.formData.address || undefined,
      birthDay: this.formData.birthDay ? this.formData.birthDay : ''
    };

    // 1. Primero actualizamos los datos de texto
    this.userService.updateUser(this.userId, updatePayload).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        // 2. Si el usuario seleccionÃ³ una foto nueva, la subimos en paralelo/secuencia
        if (this.formData.profilePictureFile && this.userId) {
          this.onUploadPhoto(this.userId, this.formData.profilePictureFile);
        } else {
          this.loading = false;
          alert('Â¡Usuario modificado con Ã©xito!');
          this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/usuarios']);
        }
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.loading = false;
        this.errorMessage = err.error?.mensaje || err.error?.message || 'Error al actualizar el usuario.';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        alert(this.errorMessage);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  onUploadPhoto(userId: number, file: File): void {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('profilePicture', file);

    this.userService.updateProfilePicture(userId, formData).subscribe({
      next: (response: any) => {
        this.loading = false;
        console.log('Foto de perfil actualizada con Ã©xito', response);
        alert('Â¡Usuario y foto de perfil modificados con Ã©xito!');
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/usuarios']);
      },
      error: (err: any) => {
        this.loading = false;
        console.error('Error al actualizar la foto', err);
        alert('Se guardaron los datos, pero hubo un error al actualizar la foto de perfil.');
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/usuarios']);
      }
    });
  }

}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\components\user-form\user-form.component.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Component, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { UserService } from '../../core/services/user.service';
import { UserDtoRequestCreation, RoleType } from '../../models/User-model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-user-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './user-form.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./user-form.component.css']
})
export class UserFormComponent {
  formData = {
    username: '',
    password: '',
    name: '',
    surname: '',
    dni: '',
    gender: '',
    email: '',
    phoneNumber: '',
    address: '',
    birthDay: '',
    role: 'GUEST' as RoleType,
    profilePictureFile: undefined as File | undefined,
    enabled: true
  };

  loading = false;
  errorMessage = '';

  constructor(
    private userService: UserService,
    private router: Router,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef
  ) {}

  onFileSelected(event: any): void {
    const file: File = event.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      this.formData.profilePictureFile = file;
    }
  }

  onSubmit(): void {
    this.errorMessage = '';
    this.loading = true;

    const payload: UserDtoRequestCreation = {
      username: this.formData.username,
      password: this.formData.password,
      name: this.formData.name,
      surname: this.formData.surname,
      dni: this.formData.dni,
      gender: this.formData.gender,
      email: this.formData.email,
      phoneNumber: this.formData.phoneNumber,
      address: this.formData.address || undefined,
      birthDay: this.formData.birthDay ? this.formData.birthDay : undefined,
      role: this.formData.role,
      profilePictureFile: this.formData.profilePictureFile,
      enabled: this.formData.enabled
    };

    this.userService.createUser(payload).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.loading = false;
        alert('Â¡Usuario creado con Ã©xito!');
        this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/usuarios']);
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.loading = false;
        this.errorMessage = err.error?.mensaje || err.error?.message || 'Error al registrar el usuario en el sistema. Verifique los datos o si el username/email/DNI ya existen.';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        alert(this.errorMessage);
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }
}

// src/app/components/user-list/user-list.component.ts
import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { UserService } from '../../core/services/user.service';
import { UserDtoResponse } from '../../models/User-model';
import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-user-list',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, RouterLink],
  templateUrl: './user-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./user-list.component.css']
})
export class UserListComponent implements OnInit {
  users: UserDtoResponse[] = [];
  loading = true;
  errorMessage = '';
  canModify = false;

  // Almacena las URLs seguras creadas con blobs para cada ID de usuario
  userAvatars: { [key: number]: string } = {};

  selectedUser: UserDtoResponse | null = null;

  constructor(
    private userService: UserService,
    private authService: AuthService,
    private router: Router,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.checkUserRole();
    this.loadUsers();
  }

  checkUserRole(): void {
    const storedRoles = localStorage.getItem('role');
    if (!storedRoles) {
      this.canModify = false;
      return;
    }

    try {
      const roles = JSON.parse(storedRoles);
      const rolesArray = Array.isArray(roles) ? roles : [roles];

      // Verificamos directamente contra el enum de Java (ADMIN, RECEPCIONIST)
      this.canModify = rolesArray.some((r: any) => {
        const roleName = typeof r === 'string' ? r : (r?.name || '');
        return roleName === 'ROLE_ADMIN' || roleName === 'ROLE_RECEPCIONIST';
      });
    } catch (e) {
      this.canModify = false;
    }
  }

  loadUsers(): void {
    this.loading = true;
    this.errorMessage = '';
    
    this.userService.getByRole('GUEST').subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.users = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
        this.loading = false;
        
        // Precargamos los avatares para cada usuario de la lista
        this.users.forEach(user => {
          this.loadUserAvatar(user);
        });

        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        this.errorMessage = 'No se pudieron cargar los huÃ©spedes.';
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        console.error(err);
      }
    });
  }

  deleteUser(id: number): void {
    if (!this.canModify) {
      alert('No tienes los permisos necesarios para realizar esta acciÃ³n.');
      return;
    }

    if (confirm('Â¿EstÃ¡s seguro de que deseas eliminar este usuario?')) {
      this.userService.deleteUser(id).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.users = this.users.filter(user => user.id !== id);
          delete this.userAvatars[id]; // Limpiamos la cachÃ© de la foto si se elimina
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        },
        error: (err) => {
          alert('Error al eliminar el usuario.');
          console.error(err);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  goToNewUser(): void {
    if (this.canModify) {
      this.router.navigate(['/dashboard/user-creation']);
    } else {
      alert('No tienes los permisos necesarios.');
    }
  }

  // MÃ©todos para controlar el modal:
  openUserDetail(user: UserDtoResponse): void {
    this.selectedUser = user;
    this.loadUserAvatar(user);
  }

  closeUserDetail(): void {
    this.selectedUser = null;
  }

  deleteUserModal(id: number): void {
    this.closeUserDetail();
    this.deleteUser(id);
  }

  // Carga la imagen mediante el servicio asegurando el envÃ­o del Token JWT
  loadUserAvatar(user: UserDtoResponse): void {
    if (!user || !user.id) return;

    // Si ya fue cargada anteriormente o estÃ¡ cargando, evitamos solicitudes repetidas
    if (this.userAvatars[user.id]) return;

    this.userService.getProfilePicture(user.id).subscribe({
      next: (blob) => {
        const objectURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        this.userAvatars[user.id] = objectURL;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
      error: (err) => {
        console.error('Error al cargar la foto de perfil', err);
        this.userAvatars[user.id] = 'assets/default-avatar.png';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    });
  }

  // Retorna la URL de objeto segura o la imagen por defecto
  getUserAvatarUrl(user: UserDtoResponse | null): string {
    if (!user || !user.id) {
      return 'assets/default-avatar.png';
    }
    return this.userAvatars[user.id] || 'assets/default-avatar.png';
  }
}

import { CanActivateFn, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';

export const authGuard: CanActivateFn = (route, state) => {
  const router = inject(Router);
  const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');

  if (token) {
    return true;
  } else {
    router.navigate(['/login']);
    return false;
  }
};




// ========================================== 
// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\core\interceptors\auth.ts 
// ==========================================


import { HttpInterceptorFn, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject } from '@angular/core';
import { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';
import { catchError, switchMap, throwError } from 'rxjs';

let isRefreshing = false;

export const authInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  const authService = inject(AuthService);
  const token = localStorage.getItem('authToken');

  let clonedReq = req;
  if (token) {
    clonedReq = req.clone({
      setHeaders: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
      }
    });
  }

  return next(clonedReq).pipe(
    catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {
      if (error.status === 401 && !req.url.includes('/public/auth/refresh') && !req.url.includes('/public/auth/login')) {
        
        if (!isRefreshing) {
          isRefreshing = true;

          return authService.refreshToken().pipe(
            switchMap((response: any) => {
              isRefreshing = false;
              
              
              const newToken = response.accessToken; 
              localStorage.setItem('authToken', newToken);

              const retryReq = req.clone({
                setHeaders: {
                  Authorization: `Bearer ${newToken}`
                }
              });
              return next(retryReq);
            }),
            catchError((refreshError) => {
              isRefreshing = false;
              localStorage.removeItem('authToken');
              return throwError(() => refreshError);
            })
          );
        }
      }

      return throwError(() => error);
    })
  );
};

    return this.http.get<PaymentDTOResponse[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/bookings/${bookingId}/payments`, { withCredentials: true });
  }

  private apiUrl = 'http://localhost:8080/public/auth'; // Ajusta segÃºn tu environment

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  login(credentials: UserLoginDtoRequest): Observable<AuthTokenResponse> {
    return this.http.post<AuthTokenResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/login`, credentials, { withCredentials: true });
  }

  logout(): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.post<void>(`${this.apiUrl}/logout`, {}, { withCredentials: true });
  }

  refreshToken(): Observable<AuthTokenResponse> {
    return this.http.post<AuthTokenResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/refresh`, {}, { withCredentials: true });
  }

  /**
   * Retorna la URL pÃºblica de la foto de perfil basada en el ID del usuario
   */
  getProfilePictureUrl(userId: number): string {
    return `${this.apiUrl}/${userId}/profile-picture`;
  }

  /**
   * Obtiene el ID numÃ©rico del usuario a partir de su username utilizando el endpoint pÃºblico
   */
  getUserIdByUsername(username: string): Observable<number> {
    return this.http.get<number>(`${this.apiUrl}/by-username/${username}`);
  }

}

// ==========================================


import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpHeaders, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { CheckInDtoResponse } from '../../models/CheckIn-model';
import { BookingDtoResponse } from '../../models/Booking-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class CheckInService {
  private apiUrl = 'http://localhost:8080/api/check-ins';
  private usersUrl = 'http://localhost:8080/api/users';
  private bookingsUrl = 'http://localhost:8080/private/booking';

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  private getAuthHeaders(): HttpHeaders {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token') || '';
    return new HttpHeaders({
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
    });
  }

  getAll(): Observable<CheckInDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<CheckInDtoResponse[]>(this.apiUrl, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  getTodayCheckIns(): Observable<BookingDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<BookingDtoResponse[]>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/today-checkins`, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  getBookingById(id: number): Observable<BookingDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.get<BookingDtoResponse>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/${id}`, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  getBookingsByState(state: string): Observable<BookingDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<BookingDtoResponse[]>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/state/${state}`, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  createCheckIn(request: any): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.post(this.apiUrl, request, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  getMyCheckIns(): Observable<CheckInDtoResponse[] > {
    return this.http.get<CheckInDtoResponse[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/my-check-ins`, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  getAllUsers(): Observable<any[]> {
    return this.http.get<any[]>(this.usersUrl, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  checkInBooking(bookingId: number, dni?: string): Observable<BookingDtoResponse> {
    let params = new HttpParams();
    if (dni) {
      params = params.set('dni', dni);
    }
    return this.http.patch<BookingDtoResponse>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/${bookingId}/check-in`, {}, { 
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders(),
      params: params 
    });
  }

  createUser(userData: any): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.post(this.usersUrl, userData, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  assignUserToBooking(bookingId: number, userId: number): Observable<BookingDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.patch<BookingDtoResponse>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/${bookingId}/assign-user/${userId}`, {}, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  interruptStay(id: number, reason: string): Observable<any> {
    return this.http.put(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}/interrupt`, { reason }, { headers: this.getAuthHeaders() });
  }

  // --- NUEVO MÃ‰TODO PARA CHECK-IN POR QR ---
  checkInByQr(qrCode: string): Observable<BookingDtoResponse> {
    const params = new HttpParams().set('qrCode', qrCode);
    return this.http.post<BookingDtoResponse>(`${this.bookingsUrl}/check-in/qr`, {}, {
      headers: this.getAuthHeaders(),
      params: params
    });
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\core\services\employee.service.ts 
// ==========================================



import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  EmployeeDtoResponse,
  EmployeeDtoRequest,
  EmployeeCreateUnifiedDTO,
  ShiftType
} from '../../models/Employee-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class EmployeeService {

  private http = inject(HttpClient);

  private readonly apiUrl ='http://localhost:8080/private/employee';

  // Obtener todos los empleados
  getAll(): Observable<EmployeeDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<EmployeeDtoResponse[]>(this.apiUrl,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  // Obtener un empleado por ID
  getById(id: number): Observable<EmployeeDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.get<EmployeeDtoResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  // Crear un empleado con sus datos de usuario
  create( employee: EmployeeCreateUnifiedDTO): Observable<EmployeeDtoResponse> {

    const formData = new FormData();

    Object.entries(employee).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        if (value instanceof File) {
          formData.append(key, value);
        } else {
          formData.append(key, String(value));
        }
      }
    });

    return this.http.post<EmployeeDtoResponse>(this.apiUrl, formData,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  // Actualizar los datos laborales de un empleado
  update( id: number, employee: EmployeeDtoRequest): Observable<EmployeeDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.put<EmployeeDtoResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`, employee,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  // Cambiar el turno de un empleado
  updateShift( id: number, nuevoShift: ShiftType): Observable<EmployeeDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.patch<EmployeeDtoResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}/shift`, null,
      {
        params: { nuevoShift },
        withCredentials: true
      });
  }

  // Eliminar el perfil laboral de un empleado
  delete(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import {
  ItemDtoRequest,
  ItemDtoResponse
} from '../../models/Item-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class ItemService {

  private http = inject(HttpClient);

  private apiUrl ='http://localhost:8080/private/items';

  //Obtiene todos los productos y servicios registrados.
  getAll(): Observable<ItemDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<ItemDtoResponse[]>(this.apiUrl,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  //Obtiene un producto o servicio especÃ­fico
  getById(id: number): Observable<ItemDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.get<ItemDtoResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  //Crear items
  createItem( request: ItemDtoRequest, image?: File): Observable<ItemDtoResponse> {

    const formData = new FormData(); //Crea contenedor para enviar datos mediante multipart/form-data, ya que tenemos datos binarios(imagen) y datos en formato json

    formData.append('item', new Blob(
        [JSON.stringify(request)],
        { type: 'application/json' }
      )
    );

    if (image) { //Agrega la imagen solamente si se proporcionÃ³ una
      formData.append('file', image);
    }

    return this.http.post<ItemDtoResponse>(this.apiUrl, formData,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }


//Actualizar item (similar a crear item pero necesita un identificador)
  updateItem(id: number, request: ItemDtoRequest, image?: File): Observable<ItemDtoResponse> {

    const formData = new FormData();

    formData.append('item', new Blob(
        [JSON.stringify(request)],
        { type: 'application/json' }
      )
    );

    if (image) {
      formData.append('file', image);
    }

    return this.http.put<ItemDtoResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`, formData,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  //Elimina un producto o servicio mediante su identificador
  deleteItem(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true });
  }

  //Obtiene la imagen de un producto
  getItemImage(id: number): Observable<Blob> {
    return this.http.get(`${this.apiUrl}/${id}/image`, {
        responseType: 'blob',
        withCredentials: true
      });
  }
}

// ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Leo\Desktop\pg\ProyectoIntegrador_UHS\Frontend\FrontHotel\src\app\core\services\payment.service.ts 
// ==========================================


import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { Observable, map } from 'rxjs';
import { AccountService } from './account.service';
import { PaymentDTOResponse } from '../../models/Payment-model';
import { AccountDTOResponse } from '../../models/Account-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class PaymentService {

  constructor(private accountService: AccountService) {}

  getAllPayments(): Observable<PaymentDTOResponse[]> {
    return this.accountService.getAllAccounts().pipe(
      map((accounts: AccountDTOResponse[]) => {
        const allPayments: PaymentDTOResponse[] = [];
        accounts.forEach((account: AccountDTOResponse) => {
          if (account.payments) {
            account.payments.forEach((payment: PaymentDTOResponse) => {
              allPayments.push(payment);
            });
          }
        });
        return allPayments;
      })
    );
  }
}

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

import { RoomDtoResponse } from '../../models/Room-model';
import { RoomDTORequest } from '../../models/Room-model';
import { RoomUpdateDTORequest } from '../../models/Room-model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class RoomService {

  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);

  private readonly apiUrl = 'http://localhost:8080/private/room';

  // Obtener todas las habitaciones
  getAll(): Observable<RoomDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<RoomDtoResponse[]>(
      this.apiUrl,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Obtener una habitaciÃ³n por ID
  getById(id: number): Observable<RoomDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.get<RoomDtoResponse>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Obtener habitaciones disponibles
  getAvailableRooms(): Observable<RoomDtoResponse[]> {
    return this.http.get<RoomDtoResponse[]>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/available`,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Crear una habitaciÃ³n con imÃ¡genes opcionales
  createRoom(
    request: RoomDTORequest,
    images: File[] = []
  ): Observable<RoomDtoResponse> {

    const formData = new FormData();

    formData.append('number', request.number.toString());
    formData.append('roomTypeId', request.roomTypeId.toString());
    formData.append('state', request.state ?? 'AVAILABLE');

    images.forEach(file => {
      formData.append('images', file, file.name);
    });

    return this.http.post<RoomDtoResponse>(
      this.apiUrl,
      formData,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Actualizar una habitaciÃ³n
  updateRoom(
    id: number,
    request: RoomUpdateDTORequest
  ): Observable<RoomDtoResponse> {

    return this.http.put<RoomDtoResponse>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      request,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Eliminar una habitaciÃ³n
  deleteRoom(id: number): Observable<void> {
    return this.http.delete<void>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}`,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Cambiar una habitaciÃ³n a mantenimiento
  putInMaintenance(id: number): Observable<RoomDtoResponse> {
    return this.http.patch<RoomDtoResponse>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}/maintenance`,
      {},
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Obtener cantidad total de habitaciones
  getRoomCount(): Observable<number> {
    return this.http.get<number>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/count`,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Agregar imÃ¡genes a una habitaciÃ³n existente
  addImages(
    id: number,
    images: File[]
  ): Observable<RoomDtoResponse> {

    const formData = new FormData();

    images.forEach(file => {
      formData.append('images', file, file.name);
    });

    return this.http.post<RoomDtoResponse>(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}/images`,
      formData,
      { withCredentials: true }
    );
  }

  // Obtener una imagen especÃ­fica
  getRoomImage(
    id: number,
    index: number
  ): Observable<Blob> {

    return this.http.get(
      `${this.apiUrl}/${id}/images/${index}`,
      {
        responseType: 'blob',
        withCredentials: true
      }
    );
  }
}
